```{r cars}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Load the dataset

df <- readRDS("data_ml_causal_0607.rds")

# 2. Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# 3. Calculate patient volume per center and shuffle randomly
centers_volumetry <- df %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(n_patients = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  sample_frac(1L) %>% 
  mutate(cumulative_patients = cumsum(n_patients))

# 4. Identify centers for the external validation cohort
# Select centers until the cumulative sum strictly exceeds 1000 patients
threshold_index <- which(centers_volumetry$cumulative_patients > 1000)[1]
validation_sites <- centers_volumetry$site_abbreviation[1:threshold_index]

# 5. Create the two distinct cohorts (geographical split)
validation_set <- df %>%
  filter(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites)

training_set <- df %>%
  filter(!(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites))

# 6. Verification of the spatial split
cat("\n--- SPATIAL SPLIT REPORT ---\n")
cat("Number of centers in the training set:", length(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the training set:", nrow(training_set), "\n")
cat("Number of centers in the validation set:", length(unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the validation set:", nrow(validation_set), "\n")

# 7. Quality control: check for data leakage across sets
leakage_check <- intersect(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation), unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation))

if(length(leakage_check) == 0) {
  cat("Spatial independence status: VALID (No overlapping centers)\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Data leakage detected between the sets.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# 2. OUTCOME DEFINITIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Primary and secondary outcomes are strictly defined to evaluate both 
# clinical efficacy and safety (competing risk of mortality).

primary_outcome <- "VAPFD_28"
secondary_outcomes <- c("VFD_28", "mortality_28d")

# We define a vector of all variables that must be strictly excluded 
# from the covariate pool to prevent target leakage.
leakage_variables <- c("VAP_status", primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes, "site_abbreviation")


# 3. TREATMENT AND COVARIATES DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# List of all VAP prevention measures evaluated in the cohort
all_prevention_measures <- c(
  "SODD", 
  "bed_elevation", 
  "sedation_vacation", 
  "thrombosis_proph", 
  "ulcer_proph", 
  "oral_care"
)

# Select the target treatment (W) for the current causal analysis.
# Example set to SODD. This can be iterated in a loop for other measures.
target_treatment <- "sedation_vacation"

# The remaining prevention measures are defined as baseline covariates.
# This adjustment is critical to isolate the specific effect of W 
# from the synergistic effect of the VAP care bundle.
other_prevention_measures <- setdiff(all_prevention_measures, target_treatment)

# Define the baseline clinical covariates (patient status at or before ICU admission)
x_prel <- c(
  # Demographic and Historical Variables
  "AGE", "SEX", "Myocardial_infarction", "congestive_heart_failure", 
  "peripherical_vascular_disease", "COPD", "connective_tissue_disease", 
  "peptic_ulcer_disease", "liver_disease", "diabetes_mellitus", 
  "CKD", "solid_tumor", "AIDS", "CVA_TIA_hemiplegia", 
  "malignant_hemopathies", "CCI_score", 
  
  # Severity and Exposure Variables
  "ICU_admission", "SOFA", "APACHE_II", "Duration_days_before_ICU", 
  
  # Pharmacological Treatments (Potential Confounders)
  "Prescription_of_ATB", "Prescription_of_IS", "LT_corticosteroids", 
  "calcineurin", "mTOR", "selective_IS", "mAB", "cancer_chemo", "other_IS"
)

# Construct the final covariate matrix X
covariates_X <- c(x_prel, other_prevention_measures)

# 4. METHODOLOGICAL QUALITY CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strictly verify that no outcome or site indicator has leaked into matrix X.

cat("\n--- CAUSAL PIPELINE: VARIABLE ALLOCATION REPORT ---\n")
cat("Target Treatment (W):", target_treatment, "\n")
cat("Primary Outcome (Y):", primary_outcome, "\n")
cat("Number of baseline covariates in X:", length(covariates_X), "\n")

leakage_check <- intersect(covariates_X, leakage_variables)

if (length(leakage_check) > 0) {
  stop("FATAL ERROR: Target leakage detected. Do not proceed with modeling.")
} else {
  cat("Integrity Check: PASSED. Zero target leakage in covariate matrix X.\n")
}
```


```{r}
# Load libraries for preprocessing and balancing
library(caret)      # Feature cleaning and cross-validated KNN imputation
library(WeightIt)   # Propensity Score and IPW calculation
library(cobalt)     # Covariate balance diagnostics (Love plots)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(recipes)    # Preprocessing and imputation

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PREPROCESSING
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 4: PREPROCESSING & IMPUTATION ---\n")

training_set <- training_set %>% drop_na(all_of(target_treatment))
validation_set <- validation_set %>% drop_na(all_of(target_treatment))

cat("Patients with missing treatment assignment excluded.\n")

# A. Feature Cleaning (Zero-variance and high correlation)
X_train_raw <- training_set[, covariates_X]
X_valid_raw <- validation_set[, covariates_X]

nzv_info <- caret::nearZeroVar(X_train_raw, saveMetrics = TRUE)
nzv_vars <- rownames(nzv_info[nzv_info$nzv == TRUE, ])
cat("Removed zero-variance variables:", length(nzv_vars), "\n")

covariates_cleaned <- setdiff(covariates_X, nzv_vars)

# B. Missing Data Imputation (k-NN) using 'recipes'
cat("Fitting k-NN imputation model on Training set (k=5)...\n")

imputation_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(c(covariates_cleaned, target_treatment), collapse = "+")))

knn_recipe <- recipe(imputation_formula, data = training_set) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_of(covariates_cleaned), neighbors = 5)

knn_prep <- prep(knn_recipe, training = training_set)

train_imputed <- bake(knn_prep, new_data = training_set)
valid_imputed <- bake(knn_prep, new_data = validation_set)

train_imputed[[target_treatment]] <- as.factor(train_imputed[[target_treatment]])
valid_imputed[[target_treatment]] <- as.factor(valid_imputed[[target_treatment]])

# C. Re-bind Outcomes
train_full <- bind_cols(train_imputed, training_set[, c(primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes)])
valid_full <- bind_cols(valid_imputed, validation_set[, c(primary_outcome, secondary_outcomes)])

cat("Preprocessing and Imputation complete. Ready for IPW balancing.\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. POSITIVITY AND OVERLAP (4 TRAIN SCENARIOS + 1 VALIDATION)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 5: POSITIVITY AND BALANCING ---\n")

apply_ipw_and_trimming <- function(data, treatment_var, cov_vars, dataset_name = "Cohort", bounds = c(0.05, 0.95)) {
  
  formula_ps <- as.formula(paste(treatment_var, "~", paste(cov_vars, collapse = "+")))
  
  # A. Initial Propensity Score Estimation
  suppressWarnings({
    ps_model <- weightit(
      formula_ps,
      data = data,
      method = "ps",
      estimand = "ATE"
    )
  })
  
  data$PS <- ps_model$ps
  data$IPW <- ps_model$weights
  
  # B. Pre-trimming diagnostics
  cat(sprintf("\nDiagnostics for %s (Pre-Trimming):\n", dataset_name))
  cat("Max IPW weight:", round(max(data$IPW), 2), "\n")
  
  # C. Trimming strategy
  trimmed_data <- data %>%
    filter(PS >= bounds[1] & PS <= bounds[2])
  
  trim_loss <- nrow(data) - nrow(trimmed_data)
  cat(sprintf("Patients excluded by Propensity Score trimming [%.3f, %.3f]: %d\n", bounds[1], bounds[2], trim_loss))
  
  # Recalculate weights on the trimmed cohort to stabilize balance
  suppressWarnings({
    ps_model_trimmed <- weightit(
      formula_ps,
      data = trimmed_data,
      method = "ps",
      estimand = "ATE"
    )
  })
  trimmed_data$IPW_final <- ps_model_trimmed$weights
  
  # D. Post-trimming diagnostics
  mean_weight <- mean(trimmed_data$IPW_final)
  cat("Mean IPW weight post-trimming (Target < 20):", round(mean_weight, 2), "\n")
  
  # E. Standardized Mean Differences (SMD)
  bal_stats <- bal.tab(ps_model_trimmed, un = TRUE)
  max_smd <- max(abs(bal_stats$Balance$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Maximum Adjusted SMD (Target < 0.1):", round(max_smd, 3), "\n")
  
  return(list(data = trimmed_data, bal_obj = ps_model_trimmed))
}

# --- GENERATION OF THE 4 TRAINING DATASETS ---

train_res_full <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(train_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                         "Training Set (Full)", bounds = c(0.000, 1.000))
train_final_full <- train_res_full$data

train_res_025 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(train_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                        "Training Set (2.5-97.5%)", bounds = c(0.025, 0.975))
train_final_025 <- train_res_025$data

train_res_05 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(train_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                       "Training Set (5-95%)", bounds = c(0.050, 0.950))
train_final_05 <- train_res_05$data

train_res_10 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(train_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                       "Training Set (10-90%)", bounds = c(0.100, 0.900))
train_final_10 <- train_res_10$data

# --- GENERATION OF THE VALIDATION DATASETS ---

valid_res_full <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(valid_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                         "Validation Set (Full)", bounds = c(0.000, 1.000))
valid_final_full <- valid_res_full$data

# 2. Validation Set (2.5-97.5%)
valid_res_025 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(valid_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                        "Validation Set (2.5-97.5%)", bounds = c(0.025, 0.975))
valid_final_025 <- valid_res_025$data

# 3. Validation Set (5-95%)
valid_res_05 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(valid_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                       "Validation Set (5-95%)", bounds = c(0.050, 0.950))
valid_final_05 <- valid_res_05$data

# 4. Validation Set (10-90%)
valid_res_10 <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(valid_full, target_treatment, covariates_cleaned, 
                                       "Validation Set (10-90%)", bounds = c(0.100, 0.900))
valid_final_10 <- valid_res_10$data


# --- VISUAL DIAGNOSTICS (LOVE PLOTS) ---

# Love plot for full validation population
love.plot(valid_res_full$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Validation Set (Full)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

# Love plot for 2.5-97.5% validation set
love.plot(valid_res_025$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Validation Set (2.5-97.5%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

# Love plot for 5-95% validation set
love.plot(valid_res_05$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Validation Set (5-95%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

# Love plot for 10-90% validation set
love.plot(valid_res_10$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Validation Set (10-90%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

# Love plots for the 4 training scenarios
love.plot(train_res_full$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Training Set (Full)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

love.plot(train_res_025$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Training Set (2.5-97.5%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

love.plot(train_res_05$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Training Set (5-95%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))

love.plot(train_res_10$bal_obj, 
          threshold = 0.1, 
          title = "Covariate Balance - Training Set (10-90%)",
          colors = c("red", "blue"))
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5.bis NUISANCE PARAMETER CALIBRATION (PROPENSITY SCORE)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- PIPELINE STEP 5.bis: PROPENSITY SCORE CALIBRATION ---\n")

# Function to evaluate and visualize calibration
evaluate_ps_calibration <- function(data, treatment_var, ps_var, dataset_name = "Cohort") {
  
  # 1. Data extraction and formatting
  obs_trt <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[treatment_var]]))
  # Enforce binary 0/1 format if encoded otherwise
  if(any(!obs_trt %in% c(0, 1))) {
    obs_trt <- ifelse(obs_trt == max(obs_trt, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0)
  }
  pred_ps <- data[[ps_var]]
  
  # 2. Brier Score computation
  brier_score <- mean((pred_ps - obs_trt)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\nCalibration diagnostics for %s:\n", dataset_name))
  cat(sprintf("Brier Score: %.4f \n", brier_score))
  
  # 3. Data preparation for calibration curve (decile approach)
  calib_data <- data.frame(Observed = obs_trt, Predicted = pred_ps) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Predicted)) %>%
    mutate(Decile = ntile(Predicted, 10)) %>%
    group_by(Decile) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Predicted = mean(Predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
      Observed_Proportion = mean(Observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      Count = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # 4. Calibration plot generation
  calib_plot <- ggplot(calib_data, aes(x = Mean_Predicted, y = Observed_Proportion)) +
    # Identity line (perfect calibration)
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    # Points and segments by deciles
    geom_point(color = "#2980B9", size = 3) +
    geom_line(color = "#2980B9", linewidth = 1) +
    
    # Local regression (LOESS) on ungrouped individual data
    geom_smooth(data = data.frame(Observed = obs_trt, Predicted = pred_ps),
                aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed),
                method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#C0392B", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Propensity Score Calibration -", dataset_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("Brier Score = %.3f", brier_score),
      x = "Mean Predicted Probability of Treatment",
      y = "Observed Proportion of Treatment"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  
  print(calib_plot)
  
  return(list(Brier_Score = brier_score, Plot = calib_plot))
}

# --- Application to key cohorts ---

# Evaluation on the full training cohort (pre-trimming) 
# Objective: verify convergence of the global logistic model.
calib_train <- evaluate_ps_calibration(
  data = train_final_full, 
  treatment_var = target_treatment, 
  ps_var = "PS", 
  dataset_name = "Training Set (Full)"
)

# Evaluation on the external validation cohort
# Objective: check for nuisance model drift on unseen data.
calib_valid <- evaluate_ps_calibration(
  data = valid_final_full, 
  treatment_var = target_treatment, 
  ps_var = "PS", 
  dataset_name = "Validation Set (Full)"
)
```

```{r}
library(grf)
library(policytree)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/policytree", recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  POLICYTREE — DISCOVERY AND OUT-OF-SAMPLE VALIDATION\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# 0. EXPLICIT VECTORS — TRAIN AND VALID
# =============================================================================
cat("--- 0. Vector initialization ---\n")

# ── TRAIN ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Y_train <- as.numeric(train_final_full[[primary_outcome]])
W_train <- as.numeric(as.character(train_final_full[[target_treatment]]))
if (any(!W_train %in% c(0, 1)))
  W_train <- ifelse(W_train == max(W_train), 1, 0)

# ── VALID ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 
Y_val <- as.numeric(valid_final_full[[primary_outcome]])
W_val <- as.numeric(as.character(valid_final_full[[target_treatment]]))
if (any(!W_val %in% c(0, 1)))
  W_val <- ifelse(W_val == max(W_val), 1, 0)

cat(sprintf("Train : N=%d | N treated=%d | N controls=%d\n",
            length(Y_train), sum(W_train == 1), sum(W_train == 0)))
cat(sprintf("Valid : N=%d | N treated=%d | N controls=%d\n",
            length(Y_val), sum(W_val == 1), sum(W_val == 0)))

# Sign convention — CRITICAL for interpretation
cat(sprintf("\n─── SIGN CONVENTION (outcome: %s) ─────────────────────\n",
            primary_outcome))
ate_brut <- mean(Y_train[W_train == 1]) - mean(Y_train[W_train == 0])
cat(sprintf("Crude observed ATE (train): %.4f\n", ate_brut))

if (primary_outcome %in% c("mortality_28d", "mortality_num")) {
  cat("ADVERSE Outcome (mortality):\n")
  cat("  ITE > 0 -> treatment INCREASES mortality -> harmful\n")
  cat("  ITE < 0 -> treatment REDUCES mortality   -> beneficial\n")
  cat("  -> PolicyTree with -Gamma: maximizes SURVIVAL\n")
  sign_gamma    <- -1
  favors_treat  <- "Favors Treatment (reduced mortality)"
  favors_ctrl   <- "Favors Control (excess mortality under treatment)"
} else {
  cat("FAVORABLE Outcome (free days):\n")
  cat("  ITE > 0 -> treatment INCREASES free days -> beneficial\n")
  cat("  ITE < 0 -> treatment REDUCES free days   -> harmful\n")
  cat("  -> PolicyTree with +Gamma: maximizes free days\n")
  sign_gamma    <- +1
  favors_treat  <- "Favors Treatment (more free days)"
  favors_ctrl   <- "Favors Control (fewer free days under treatment)"
}

# =============================================================================
# 1. SINGLE ENCODING LEARNED ON TRAIN
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 1. One-hot encoding (dummy_train) ---\n")

dummy_train     <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_final_full[, covariates_cleaned])
X_train_numeric <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_train,
                                      newdata = train_final_full[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_train_numeric[is.na(X_train_numeric)] <- 0

# Strict application of the SAME encoding on valid
X_val_numeric <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_train,
                                    newdata = valid_final_full[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_val_numeric[is.na(X_val_numeric)] <- 0

cat(sprintf("Dim X_train : %d x %d\n", nrow(X_train_numeric), ncol(X_train_numeric)))
cat(sprintf("Dim X_valid : %d x %d\n", nrow(X_val_numeric),   ncol(X_val_numeric)))

if (ncol(X_train_numeric) != ncol(X_val_numeric)) {
  stop("CRITICAL ERROR: incompatible dimensions between X_train and X_valid.")
}

X_train_policy <- X_train_numeric
X_val_policy   <- X_val_numeric

# =============================================================================
# 2. EXPLICIT NUISANCES VIA CROSS-FITTING (replaces Y.forest/W.forest)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 2. Explicit nuisances via cross-fitting ---\n")

library(ranger)

set.seed(2026)
cv_folds_pt <- createFolds(Y_train, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

m_hat_train <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_train))  # E[Y|X]
e_hat_train <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_train))  # E[W|X]

df_nuis <- data.frame(X_train_policy, Y = Y_train, W = as.factor(W_train))

for (k in 1:5) {
  test_k  <- cv_folds_pt[[k]]
  train_k <- setdiff(seq_along(Y_train), test_k)

  # m(x) = E[Y|X]
  fit_m <- ranger(Y ~ ., num.threads = 2, seed = 2026,
                  data = df_nuis[train_k, !names(df_nuis) %in% "W"])
  m_hat_train[test_k] <- predict(fit_m,
                                  data = df_nuis[test_k, ])$predictions

  # e(x) = E[W|X]
  fit_e <- ranger(W ~ ., num.threads = 2, seed = 2026,
                  probability = TRUE,
                  data = df_nuis[train_k, !names(df_nuis) %in% "Y"])
  probs <- predict(fit_e, data = df_nuis[test_k, ])$predictions
  col1  <- which(colnames(probs) == "1")
  e_hat_train[test_k] <- pmin(pmax(probs[, col1], 0.02), 0.98)
}

cat(sprintf("m_hat_train — Mean: %.3f | SD: %.3f\n",
            mean(m_hat_train, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(m_hat_train,   na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("e_hat_train — Mean: %.3f | Range: [%.3f ; %.3f]\n",
            mean(e_hat_train),
            min(e_hat_train),
            max(e_hat_train)))

# Global models for prediction on VALID
fit_m_global <- ranger(Y ~ ., num.threads = 2, seed = 2026,
                        data = df_nuis[, !names(df_nuis) %in% "W"])
fit_e_global <- ranger(W ~ ., num.threads = 2, seed = 2026,
                        probability = TRUE,
                        data = df_nuis[, !names(df_nuis) %in% "Y"])

# Predictions on VALID from models trained on TRAIN
df_valid_nuis <- data.frame(X_val_policy)

m_hat_val <- predict(fit_m_global, data = df_valid_nuis)$predictions

probs_val  <- predict(fit_e_global, data = df_valid_nuis)$predictions
col1_val   <- which(colnames(probs_val) == "1")
e_hat_val  <- pmin(pmax(probs_val[, col1_val], 0.02), 0.98)

cat(sprintf("m_hat_val — Mean: %.3f\n", mean(m_hat_val, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("e_hat_val — Mean: %.3f | Range: [%.3f ; %.3f]\n",
            mean(e_hat_val), min(e_hat_val), max(e_hat_val)))

# =============================================================================
# 3. CAUSAL FOREST WITH EXPLICIT NUISANCES
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 3. Causal Forest (explicit nuisances) ---\n")

set.seed(2026)
cf_policy <- causal_forest(
  X         = X_train_policy,
  Y         = Y_train,
  W         = W_train,
  Y.hat     = m_hat_train,   # <- explicit cross-fitted nuisance
  W.hat     = e_hat_train,   # <- explicit cross-fitted nuisance
  num.trees = 2000,
  seed      = 2026
)

cat(sprintf("ATE GRF: %.4f (SE: %.4f)\n",
            average_treatment_effect(cf_policy)["estimate"],
            average_treatment_effect(cf_policy)["std.err"]))

# =============================================================================
# 4. DR-SCORES (consistent with explicit nuisances)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 4. DR-scores ---\n")

dr_matrix_train <- double_robust_scores(cf_policy)
colnames(dr_matrix_train) <- c("Control", "Treatment")

ite_dr_train <- dr_matrix_train[, "Treatment"] - dr_matrix_train[, "Control"]
cat(sprintf("Mean DR ITE: %.4f | Proportion < 0: %.1f%%\n",
            mean(ite_dr_train, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean(ite_dr_train < 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100))

# =============================================================================
# 5. PROJECTION ON VALID — without Y.forest/W.forest
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 5. Projection on valid ---\n")

# Safety alignment — enforce identical columns in the exact same order
X_val_policy <- X_val_policy[, colnames(X_train_policy), drop = FALSE]
X_val_policy[is.na(X_val_policy)] <- 0

# tau_hat from the causal forest (train -> valid)
tau_hat_val <- predict(cf_policy, X_val_policy)$predictions

# mu_1 and mu_0 reconstructed from GLOBAL nuisances (train -> valid)
W_hat_val_clip <- pmin(pmax(e_hat_val, 0.01), 0.99)

mu_1_val <- m_hat_val + (1 - W_hat_val_clip) * tau_hat_val
mu_0_val <- m_hat_val - W_hat_val_clip * tau_hat_val

# Consistency check
cor_check <- cor(tau_hat_val, mu_1_val - mu_0_val)
cat(sprintf("Correlation tau vs (mu_1 - mu_0): %.4f [%s]\n",
            cor_check,
            ifelse(abs(cor_check) > 0.99, "OK", "WARNING")))

# Clipping diagnostic
n_clip <- sum(e_hat_val < 0.01 | e_hat_val > 0.99)
cat(sprintf("PS Clipping [0.01;0.99]: %d obs (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_clip, n_clip / length(e_hat_val) * 100))

# AIPW Gamma on valid
gamma_1_val <- mu_1_val +
  W_val / W_hat_val_clip * (Y_val - mu_1_val)
gamma_0_val <- mu_0_val +
  (1 - W_val) / (1 - W_hat_val_clip) * (Y_val - mu_0_val)

valid_final_full$pseudo_ITE <- gamma_1_val - gamma_0_val
valid_final_full$tau_hat     <- tau_hat_val

cat(sprintf("Valid pseudo-ITE — Mean: %.4f | SD: %.4f\n",
            mean(valid_final_full$pseudo_ITE, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(valid_final_full$pseudo_ITE,   na.rm = TRUE)))

# =============================================================================
# 6. LEAF-LEVEL ESTIMATION + MULTIPLICITY CORRECTION
# =============================================================================
# 1. Extract variable importance from the training causal forest
varimp <- variable_importance(cf_policy)

# 2. Select the top 15 most discriminating clinical variables
top_vars_idx <- order(varimp, decreasing = TRUE)
top_vars_names <- colnames(X_train_policy)[top_vars_idx]

cat("Top 15 variables selected for policy learning:\n")
print(top_vars_names)

# 3. Strict restriction of training and validation matrices
X_train_tree <- X_train_policy[, top_vars_names, drop = FALSE]
X_val_tree   <- X_val_policy[, top_vars_names, drop = FALSE]
X_val_tree[is.na(X_val_tree)] <- 0

# Gamma oriented according to sign convention
Gamma_policy <- sign_gamma * dr_matrix_train
 
set.seed(2026)
# Execution time is controlled despite exhaustive search
opt_tree <- policy_tree(
  X     = X_train_tree,
  Gamma = Gamma_policy,
  depth = 3   
)
 
cat("\nCausal decision tree structure:\n")
print(opt_tree)

# Identify leaves using X_val_tree
valid_final_full$tree_action <- predict(opt_tree, X_val_tree)
valid_final_full$tree_leaf   <- predict(opt_tree, X_val_tree,
                                         type = "node.id")

leaves <- sort(unique(valid_final_full$tree_leaf))
n_leaves <- length(leaves)

cat(sprintf("Number of active leaves: %d\n\n", n_leaves))

# Collect raw p-values
leaf_results <- data.frame()

for (leaf in leaves) {
  idx    <- which(valid_final_full$tree_leaf == leaf)
  pseudo <- valid_final_full$pseudo_ITE[idx]
  pseudo <- pseudo[!is.na(pseudo)]
  n_leaf <- length(pseudo)
  action <- unique(valid_final_full$tree_action[idx])

  if (n_leaf > 1) {
    ate_leaf <- mean(pseudo)
    se_leaf  <- sd(pseudo) / sqrt(n_leaf)
    p_raw    <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(ate_leaf / se_leaf))
    ci_lo    <- ate_leaf - 1.96 * se_leaf
    ci_hi    <- ate_leaf + 1.96 * se_leaf

    leaf_results <- rbind(leaf_results, data.frame(
      Leaf       = leaf,
      N          = n_leaf,
      Action     = ifelse(action == 2, "Treat", "Abstain"),
      ATE        = round(ate_leaf, 4),
      SE         = round(se_leaf,  4),
      CI_Lo      = round(ci_lo,    4),
      CI_Hi      = round(ci_hi,    4),
      p_raw      = p_raw,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Benjamini-Hochberg correction (FDR control)
leaf_results$p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(leaf_results$p_raw, method = "BH")
leaf_results$Sig_raw   <- ifelse(leaf_results$p_raw   < 0.05, "*", "ns")
leaf_results$Sig_BH    <- ifelse(leaf_results$p_adj_BH < 0.05, "*", "ns")

cat("Results by leaf (doubly robust pseudo-ITE):\n\n")
print(leaf_results %>%
        mutate(p_raw   = format.pval(p_raw,   digits = 3),
               p_adj_BH = format.pval(p_adj_BH, digits = 3)),
      row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 7. POLICY COMPARISON (Doubly robust AIPW)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 7. Policy comparison ---\n")

# ML Policy = tree decision
valid_final_full$W_ml_policy <- as.integer(valid_final_full$tree_action == 2)

# AIPW estimator for each policy
compute_policy_value <- function(policy_W, gamma_1, gamma_0) {
  # Expected value of policy pi(x)
  val <- mean(policy_W * gamma_1 + (1 - policy_W) * gamma_0, na.rm = TRUE)
  se  <- sd(policy_W * gamma_1 + (1 - policy_W) * gamma_0, na.rm = TRUE) /
         sqrt(sum(!is.na(gamma_1)))
  list(value = val, se = se,
       ci_lo = val - 1.96 * se,
       ci_hi = val + 1.96 * se)
}

pol_ml    <- compute_policy_value(valid_final_full$W_ml_policy,
                                   gamma_1_val, gamma_0_val)
pol_all   <- compute_policy_value(rep(1, nrow(valid_final_full)),
                                   gamma_1_val, gamma_0_val)
pol_none  <- compute_policy_value(rep(0, nrow(valid_final_full)),
                                   gamma_1_val, gamma_0_val)

# Regret = difference vs best possible policy
policy_summary <- data.frame(
  Policy   = c("ML PolicyTree", "Treat All", "Treat None"),
  Value    = round(c(pol_ml$value, pol_all$value, pol_none$value), 4),
  SE       = round(c(pol_ml$se,    pol_all$se,    pol_none$se),    4),
  CI_Lo    = round(c(pol_ml$ci_lo, pol_all$ci_lo, pol_none$ci_lo), 4),
  CI_Hi    = round(c(pol_ml$ci_hi, pol_all$ci_hi, pol_none$ci_hi), 4)
)

best_val <- max(policy_summary$Value)
policy_summary$Regret <- round(best_val - policy_summary$Value, 4)

cat("Policy comparison (expected value — AIPW estimator):\n\n")
print(policy_summary, row.names = FALSE)

# Test ML vs Treat None
diff_ml_none <- pol_ml$value - pol_none$value
se_diff      <- sqrt(pol_ml$se^2 + pol_none$se^2)
p_diff       <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(diff_ml_none / se_diff))

cat(sprintf("\nML PolicyTree vs Treat None: Delta = %.4f (SE: %.4f) | p = %s\n",
            diff_ml_none, se_diff,
            format.pval(p_diff, digits = 3)))

# =============================================================================
# 8. PLOT — EFFECTS BY LEAF
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 8. Plot ---\n")

p_leaves <- ggplot(
  leaf_results,
  aes(x = ATE, y = factor(Leaf),
      colour = Sig_BH, fill = Sig_BH)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lo, xmax = CI_Hi),
                 height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", N, " | ", Action)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2, colour = "#2C3E50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("*"  = "#E74C3C", "ns" = "#7F8C8D"),
                      labels = c("*"  = "Sig (BH p<0.05)",
                                 "ns" = "Non significant")) +
  scale_fill_manual(  values = c("*"  = "#E74C3C", "ns" = "#2980B9"),
                      labels = c("*"  = "Sig (BH p<0.05)",
                                 "ns" = "Non significant")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Causal PolicyTree — ATE by leaf (external validation)"),
    subtitle = paste0("Outcome: ", primary_outcome,
                      " | Treatment: ", target_treatment,
                      " | depth=3 | N=", nrow(valid_final_full),
                      " | Multiplicity correction: BH"),
    x        = paste0("Estimated ATE (DR pseudo-ITE) — ", favors_treat),
    y        = "Tree leaf",
    colour   = NULL, fill = NULL,
    caption  = paste0(
      "Tree learned on derivation cohort, projected onto external validation cohort\n",
      "p-values adjusted via Benjamini-Hochberg method (5% FDR)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p_leaves)

# =============================================================================
# END
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  POLICYTREE COMPLETED\n")
cat("  Outputs : CLEAN_VAP_outputs/policytree/\n")
cat("  ├── leaf_results_valid.csv\n")
cat("  ├── policy_comparison_valid.csv\n")
cat("  └── fig_policytree_leaves_*.pdf\n")
cat("=============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. VALIDATION SET TRIMMING
#    MAIN ADJUSTMENT: exclude patients with extreme PS
#    to stabilize DR scores on the validation set
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 6. Validation PS trimming [0.05 ; 0.95] ---\n")
 
# Trimming thresholds
ps_lo <- 0.05
ps_hi <- 0.95
 
# Identify patients within the acceptable overlap region
idx_trim <- which(e_hat_val >= ps_lo & e_hat_val <= ps_hi)
idx_excl <- which(e_hat_val <  ps_lo | e_hat_val >  ps_hi)
 
cat(sprintf("Full validation N            : %d\n", length(Y_val)))
cat(sprintf("Excluded N (PS outside [%.2f;%.2f]): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            ps_lo, ps_hi, length(idx_excl),
            length(idx_excl) / length(Y_val) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Validation N post-trimming   : %d\n", length(idx_trim)))
cat(sprintf("Treated N  (trimmed) : %d\n", sum(W_val[idx_trim] == 1)))
cat(sprintf("Control N  (trimmed) : %d\n", sum(W_val[idx_trim] == 0)))
 
# Trimmed subsets
X_val_trim      <- X_val_policy[idx_trim, , drop = FALSE]
Y_val_trim      <- Y_val[idx_trim]
W_val_trim      <- W_val[idx_trim]
m_hat_val_trim  <- m_hat_val[idx_trim]
e_hat_val_trim  <- e_hat_val[idx_trim]
 
cat(sprintf("\ne_hat_val (trimmed) — Mean: %.3f | Range: [%.3f ; %.3f]\n",
            mean(e_hat_val_trim),
            min(e_hat_val_trim),
            max(e_hat_val_trim)))
 
# =============================================================================
# 7. PROJECTION AND DR SCORES ON TRIMMED VALIDATION SET
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 7. Projection on trimmed validation set ---\n")
 
# Column alignment (safety check)
col_tree   <- opt_tree$columns
X_val_tree <- X_val_trim[, col_tree, drop = FALSE]
X_val_tree[is.na(X_val_tree)] <- 0
 
cat(sprintf("Dim X_val_tree : %d x %d | opt_tree n.features : %d\n",
            nrow(X_val_tree), ncol(X_val_tree), opt_tree$n.features))
 
if (ncol(X_val_tree) != opt_tree$n.features)
  stop("ERROR: X_val_tree columns are incompatible with opt_tree.")
 
# tau_hat on trimmed validation set
tau_hat_trim <- predict(cf_policy, X_val_trim)$predictions
 
# Reconstruct mu_1 / mu_0
W_hat_trim_clip <- pmin(pmax(e_hat_val_trim, 0.01), 0.99)
mu_1_trim <- m_hat_val_trim + (1 - W_hat_trim_clip) * tau_hat_trim
mu_0_trim <- m_hat_val_trim - W_hat_trim_clip * tau_hat_trim
 
# Consistency check
cor_check <- cor(tau_hat_trim, mu_1_trim - mu_0_trim)
cat(sprintf("Correlation tau vs (mu_1-mu_0): %.4f [%s]\n",
            cor_check,
            ifelse(abs(cor_check) > 0.99, "OK", "WARNING")))
 
# DR scores on trimmed validation set
gamma_1_trim <- mu_1_trim +
  W_val_trim / W_hat_trim_clip * (Y_val_trim - mu_1_trim)
gamma_0_trim <- mu_0_trim +
  (1 - W_val_trim) / (1 - W_hat_trim_clip) * (Y_val_trim - mu_0_trim)
 
pseudo_ITE_trim <- gamma_1_trim - gamma_0_trim
 
cat(sprintf("Pseudo-ITE (trimmed) — Mean: %.4f | SD: %.4f\n",
            mean(pseudo_ITE_trim, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(pseudo_ITE_trim,   na.rm = TRUE)))
 
# Stabilization check (SD should be < 2 for 0/1 mortality)
if (sd(pseudo_ITE_trim, na.rm = TRUE) > 2) {
  warning("WARNING: pseudo-ITE SD remains high despite trimming — interpret results with caution.")
} else {
  cat("OK: pseudo-ITE SD stabilized by trimming.\n")
}
 
# Tree projection

tree_leaf_trim   <- predict(opt_tree, X_val_tree, type = "node.id")

            sum(tree_action_trim == 2),
            mean(tree_action_trim == 2) * 100))
cat(sprintf("N recommended abstention (action=1): %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(tree_action_trim == 1),
            mean(tree_action_trim == 1) * 100))
 
# =============================================================================
# 8. ATE BY LEAF + MULTIPLICITY CORRECTION (BH)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 8. ATE by leaf (trimmed validation set) ---\n")
 
leaves   <- sort(unique(tree_leaf_trim))
n_leaves <- length(leaves)
cat(sprintf("Number of active leaves: %d\n\n", n_leaves))
 
leaf_results <- data.frame()
 
for (leaf in leaves) {
  idx    <- which(tree_leaf_trim == leaf)
  pseudo <- pseudo_ITE_trim[idx]
  pseudo <- pseudo[!is.na(pseudo)]
  n_leaf <- length(pseudo)
  action <- unique(tree_action_trim[idx])
 
  if (n_leaf > 1) {
    ate_leaf <- mean(pseudo)
    se_leaf  <- sd(pseudo) / sqrt(n_leaf)
    p_raw    <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(ate_leaf / se_leaf))
    ci_lo    <- ate_leaf - 1.96 * se_leaf
    ci_hi    <- ate_leaf + 1.96 * se_leaf
 
    leaf_results <- rbind(leaf_results, data.frame(
      Leaf   = leaf,
      N      = n_leaf,
      Action = ifelse(action == 2, "Treat", "Abstain"),
      ATE    = round(ate_leaf, 4),
      SE     = round(se_leaf,  4),
      CI_Lo  = round(ci_lo,    4),
      CI_Hi  = round(ci_hi,    4),
      p_raw  = p_raw,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}
 
# BH correction
leaf_results$p_adj_BH <- p.adjust(leaf_results$p_raw, method = "BH")
leaf_results$Sig_raw   <- ifelse(leaf_results$p_raw   < 0.05, "*", "ns")
leaf_results$Sig_BH    <- ifelse(leaf_results$p_adj_BH < 0.05, "*", "ns")

compute_policy_value <- function(policy_W, g1, g0) {

}

)

# Test ML vs Treat None

se_diff      <- sqrt(pol_ml$se^2 + pol_none$se^2)

            diff_ml_all, se_diff_all,

    caption = paste0(

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

cat("=============================================================\n")

            length(idx_trim),
            length(idx_trim) / length(Y_val) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Pseudo-ITE SD (trimmed)      : %.4f [%s]\n",
            sd(pseudo_ITE_trim, na.rm = TRUE),
            ifelse(sd(pseudo_ITE_trim, na.rm = TRUE) < 2,
                   "Stable", "Unstable")))
cat(sprintf("Significant leaves (BH)      : %d / %d\n",
            sum(leaf_results$Sig_BH == "*"), nrow(leaf_results)))
cat(sprintf("ML vs Treat None : p = %s\n",
            format.pval(p_diff, digits = 3)))
cat(sprintf("ML vs Treat All  : p = %s\n",
            format.pval(p_diff_all, digits = 3)))
cat("\nOutputs :\n")
cat("  ├── leaf_results_valid_trim.csv\n")
cat("  ├── policy_comparison_valid_trim.csv\n")
cat("  └── fig_policytree_trim_*.pdf\n")
cat("=============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REQUIRED PACKAGE INSTALLATION (Uncomment if needed)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# install.packages(c("tmle", "SuperLearner", "grf", "DoubleML", "mlr3learners", "bcf", "ggplot2", "AIPW"))
# remotes::install_github("vdorie/bartCause") # bartCause is not always on CRAN

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(tmle)
library(SuperLearner)
library(bartCause)
library(grf)
library(bcf)
library(DoubleML)
library(mlr3learners)
library(AIPW)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POOLING AND POSITIVITY (Based on your previous code)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- 1. POOLING AND POSITIVITY ---\n")

# Pooling the imputed datasets
df_full <- bind_rows(train_final_full, valid_final_full)

# Applying your trimming function to the overall cohort
global_balanced_results <- apply_ipw_and_trimming(
  data = df_full, 
  treatment_var = target_treatment, 
  cov_vars = covariates_cleaned, 
  dataset_name = "Cohorte Globale"
)
df_final <- global_balanced_results$data

# Extracting the strict vectors
Y <- df_final[[primary_outcome]]
W <- as.numeric(as.character(df_final[[target_treatment]]))
# Strict binarization of W (0/1) if not already the case
if(any(!W %in% c(0, 1))) W <- ifelse(W == max(W), 1, 0) 
PS_hat <- df_final$PS # Pre-computed propensity score

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. ONE-HOT ENCODING (Required for GRF, BCF, DoubleML)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Transforming covariates into a strict numeric matrix...\n")
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_final[, covariates_cleaned])
X_mat <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = df_final[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_df <- as.data.frame(X_mat)

# Initializing the results table
results <- data.frame(
  Approach = character(),
  Estimate = numeric(),
  StdError = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Utility function to add a row to the table
add_result <- function(name, est, se) {
  results <<- rbind(results, data.frame(Approach = name, Estimate = est, StdError = se))
  cat("Done:", name, "- ATE:", round(est, 3), "\n")
}

cat("\n--- 3. RUNNING THE ATE ESTIMATORS ---\n")

# --- 1 & 2. OLS (Ordinary Least Squares) ---
ols_unadj <- lm(Y ~ W)
add_result("OLS, unadjusted", coef(ols_unadj)["W"], summary(ols_unadj)$coefficients["W", "Std. Error"])

data_ols_adj <- data.frame(Y = Y, W = W, X_df)
ols_adj <- lm(Y ~ ., data = data_ols_adj)
add_result("OLS, adjusted", coef(ols_adj)["W"], summary(ols_adj)$coefficients["W", "Std. Error"])

# --- 3. AIPW (Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting) ---
# Using a simple outcome model (glm) for the classic AIPW
aipw_obj <- AIPW$new(Y = Y, A = W, W = X_df, 
                     Q.SL.library = "SL.glm", 
                     g.SL.library = "SL.glm", 
                     k_split = 3)
aipw_obj$fit()
aipw_res <- aipw_obj$summary()
add_result("AIPW", aipw_res$estimates$RD[1], aipw_res$estimates$RD[2])

# --- 4. TMLE (Random Forest) ---

                Q.SL.library = "SL.ranger", 
                g.SL.library = "SL.ranger")
add_result("TMLE (Random Forest)", tmle_rf$estimates$ATE$psi, sqrt(tmle_rf$estimates$ATE$var.psi))

# --- 5. TMLE (Super Learner) ---

                Q.SL.library = sl_lib, 
                g.SL.library = sl_lib)
add_result("TMLE (Super Learner)", tmle_sl$estimates$ATE$psi, sqrt(tmle_sl$estimates$ATE$var.psi))

# --- 6. BART Standard (bartCause) ---
bart_std <- bartc(response = Y, treatment = W, confounders = X_mat, 
                  method.trt = "none", method.rsp = "bart", 
                  keepTrees = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
add_result("BART Standard (bartCause)", summary(bart_std)$estimates$estimate, summary(bart_std)$estimates$sd)

# --- 7. ps-BART (Official Pkg) ---
ps_bart <- bartc(response = Y, treatment = W, confounders = X_mat, 
                 method.trt = "bart", method.rsp = "bart", 
                 keepTrees = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
add_result("ps-BART (Official Pkg)", summary(ps_bart)$estimates$estimate, summary(ps_bart)$estimates$sd)


# --- 9. GRF (Causal Forest) ---
cf <- causal_forest(X_mat, Y, W, W.hat = PS_hat)
cf_ate <- average_treatment_effect(cf, target.sample = "all")
add_result("GRF", cf_ate["estimate"], cf_ate["std.err"])

# --- 10. Double ML (IRM - Interactive Regression Model) ---
df_dml <- data.frame(Y = Y, W = W, X_df)
task_dml <- DoubleMLData$new(df_dml, y_col = "Y", d_cols = "W")

# ML learners from mlr3 (Ranger for both outcome and propensity)
ml_l <- lrn("regr.ranger", num.trees = 500)
ml_m <- lrn("classif.ranger", num.trees = 500)

# FIX: trimming_threshold with an "underscore"
dml_irm <- DoubleMLIRM$new(
  task_dml, 
  ml_g = ml_l, 
  ml_m = ml_m, 
  trimming_rule = "truncate",
  trimming_threshold = 0.05
)

dml_irm$fit()
add_result("Double ML (IRM)", dml_irm$coef, dml_irm$se)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. TABLE AND PLOT CREATION (FOREST PLOT)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Computing the 95% confidence intervals
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    CI_Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * StdError,
    CI_Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * StdError
  )

# Displaying the formatted table
cat("\n\n--- ATE SUMMARY TABLE ---\n")
print(results, digits = 3)

# Display order for the plot (to respect the execution order)
results$Approach <- factor(results$Approach, levels = rev(results$Approach))

# Creating the Forest Plot
p_forest <- ggplot(results, aes(x = Estimate, y = Approach)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper), height = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Average Treatment Effect (ATE) estimators comparison"),
    subtitle = paste("Outcome:", primary_outcome, "| Treatment:", target_treatment),
    x = "Estimated ATE (95% CI)",
    y = "Methodological Approach"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_forest)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — CAUSAL ESTIMATORS (ATT & ATO)
# Main fix: AIPW extraction via $result instead of $summary()
# =============================================================================

library(WeightIt); library(caret); library(grf)
library(tmle); library(SuperLearner)
library(DoubleML); library(mlr3); library(mlr3learners)
library(AIPW); library(bartCause)
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

# =============================================================================
# 1. GLOBAL PROPENSITY SCORE
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 1. PROPENSITY SCORE ---\n")

df_full <- bind_rows(train_final_full, valid_final_full)

formula_ps_global <- as.formula(
  paste(target_treatment, "~", paste(covariates_cleaned, collapse = "+"))
)
ps_model_global <- weightit(
  formula_ps_global,
  data      = df_full,
  method    = "ps",
  estimand  = "ATE"
)

df_final     <- df_full
df_final$PS  <- ps_model_global$ps

Y      <- as.numeric(df_final[[primary_outcome]])
W      <- as.numeric(as.character(df_final[[target_treatment]]))
if (any(!W %in% c(0, 1))) W <- ifelse(W == max(W), 1, 0)
PS_hat <- df_final$PS

cat(sprintf("Total N: %d | Treated N: %d | Control N: %d\n",
            length(W), sum(W == 1), sum(W == 0)))
cat(sprintf("PS — min: %.3f | mean: %.3f | max: %.3f\n",
            min(PS_hat), mean(PS_hat), max(PS_hat)))

# =============================================================================
# 2. ONE-HOT ENCODING
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 2. ONE-HOT ENCODING ---\n")

dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_final[, covariates_cleaned])
X_mat       <- as.matrix(
  predict(dummy_model, newdata = df_final[, covariates_cleaned])
)
X_mat[is.na(X_mat)] <- 0
X_df        <- as.data.frame(X_mat)

cat(sprintf("X matrix: %d rows × %d columns\n", nrow(X_mat), ncol(X_mat)))

# =============================================================================
# 3. INITIALIZING THE RESULTS TABLE
# =============================================================================
results <- data.frame(
  Approach = character(),
  Estimate = numeric(),
  StdError = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

add_result <- function(name, est, se) {
  est <- as.numeric(est)
  se  <- as.numeric(se)
  results <<- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(Approach = name, Estimate = est, StdError = se,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-25s Estimate = %7.3f  SE = %.3f\n", name, est, se))
}

# =============================================================================
# 4. CAUSAL ESTIMATORS
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 3. ESTIMATORS (ATT & ATO) ---\n")

# ── 1. GRF (Causal Forest) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[1/6] Causal Forest (GRF)...\n")
set.seed(2026)
cf <- causal_forest(
  X         = X_mat,
  Y         = Y,
  W         = W,
  W.hat     = PS_hat,
  num.trees = 2000,
  tune.parameters = "all"
)
cf_att <- average_treatment_effect(cf, target.sample = "treated")
cf_ato <- average_treatment_effect(cf, target.sample = "overlap")
add_result("GRF (ATT)",     cf_att["estimate"], cf_att["std.err"])
add_result("GRF (ATO)",     cf_ato["estimate"], cf_ato["std.err"])

# ── 2. TMLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[2/6] TMLE...\n")
tmle_fit <- tryCatch({
  tmle(
    Y            = Y,
    A            = W,
    W            = X_df,
    Q.SL.library = "SL.ranger",
    g.SL.library = "SL.ranger"
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("TMLE ranger failed, falling back to SL.glm: ", conditionMessage(e))
  tmle(Y = Y, A = W, W = X_df,
       Q.SL.library = "SL.glm",
       g.SL.library = "SL.glm")
})
add_result("TMLE (ATT)",
           tmle_fit$estimates$ATT$psi,
           sqrt(tmle_fit$estimates$ATT$var.psi))

# ── 3. Double ML (IRM — ATTE) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[3/6] Double ML (IRM-ATTE)...\n")
df_dml   <- data.frame(Y = Y, W = W, X_df)
task_dml <- DoubleMLData$new(df_dml, y_col = "Y", d_cols = "W")

dml_irm <- DoubleMLIRM$new(
  task_dml,
  ml_g               = lrn("regr.ranger",   num.trees = 500),
  ml_m               = lrn("classif.ranger", num.trees = 500),
  score              = "ATTE",
  trimming_rule      = "truncate",
  trimming_threshold = 0.05
)
dml_irm$fit()
add_result("Double ML (ATT)", dml_irm$coef, dml_irm$se)

# ── 4. AIPW ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FIX: $summary() returns invisible(self) → a non-subsettable environment.
# The extractable results are in $result (data.frame).
cat("\n[4/6] AIPW...\n")

aipw_obj <- AIPW$new(
  Y            = Y,
  A            = W,
  W            = X_df,
  Q.SL.library = "SL.glm",
  g.SL.library = "SL.glm",
  k_split      = 3,
  verbose      = FALSE
)

suppressWarnings(aipw_obj$stratified_fit())

# Console display (optional)
aipw_obj$summary()

# ── Robust extraction from $result ────────────────────────────────────────
aipw_result_df <- tryCatch(
  aipw_obj$result,
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(aipw_result_df) &&
    "ATT Mean Difference" %in% rownames(aipw_result_df)) {

  # Access by row name — primary method
  est_aipw <- as.numeric(aipw_result_df["ATT Mean Difference", "Estimate"])
  se_aipw  <- as.numeric(aipw_result_df["ATT Mean Difference", "SE"])

} else if (!is.null(aipw_result_df) && nrow(aipw_result_df) >= 4) {

  # Fallback: 4th row (standard order: Exposed / Control / ATE / ATT)
  cat("  ⚠ Rowname 'ATT Mean Difference' missing → falling back to row 4\n")
  est_aipw <- as.numeric(aipw_result_df[4, "Estimate"])
  se_aipw  <- as.numeric(aipw_result_df[4, "SE"])

} else {

  # Final fallback: parse the captured console output
  cat("  ⚠ $result unavailable → extracting from capture.output()\n")
  captured <- capture.output(aipw_obj$summary())
  att_line  <- grep("ATT", captured, value = TRUE)
  if (length(att_line) > 0) {
    nums     <- as.numeric(unlist(regmatches(
      att_line,
      gregexpr("-?[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", att_line)
    )))
    est_aipw <- nums[1]
    se_aipw  <- nums[2]
  } else {
    warning("AIPW: extraction completely failed — NA values.")
    est_aipw <- NA_real_
    se_aipw  <- NA_real_
  }
}

add_result("AIPW (ATT)", est_aipw, se_aipw)

# ── 5. BART Standard (ATT) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[5/6] BART Standard (ATT)...\n")
bart_att <- tryCatch({
  bartc(
    response     = Y,
    treatment    = W,
    confounders  = X_mat,
    method.trt   = "none",
    method.rsp   = "bart",
    estimand     = "att",
    keepTrees    = FALSE,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    seed         = 2026
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("BART Standard failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
})

if (!is.null(bart_att)) {
  bart_att_sum <- summary(bart_att)$estimates
  add_result("BART Standard (ATT)",
             bart_att_sum$estimate,
             bart_att_sum$sd)
} else {
  cat("  ✗ BART Standard skipped (error).\n")
}

# ── 6. ps-BART (ATT) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n[6/6] ps-BART (ATT)...\n")
ps_bart_att <- tryCatch({
  bartc(
    response     = Y,
    treatment    = W,
    confounders  = X_mat,
    method.trt   = "bart",
    method.rsp   = "bart",
    estimand     = "att",
    keepTrees    = FALSE,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    seed         = 2026
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("ps-BART failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
})

if (!is.null(ps_bart_att)) {
  ps_bart_sum <- summary(ps_bart_att)$estimates
  add_result("ps-BART (ATT)",
             ps_bart_sum$estimate,
             ps_bart_sum$sd)
} else {
  cat("  ✗ ps-BART skipped (error).\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# 5. CONFIDENCE INTERVALS & FOREST PLOT
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- 4. RESULTS AND FOREST PLOT ---\n")

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    CI_Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * StdError,
    CI_Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * StdError,
    Significant = ifelse(CI_Lower > 0 | CI_Upper < 0, "Significant", "NS"),
    Approach = factor(Approach, levels = rev(Approach))
  )

cat("\nSummary table:\n")
print(results %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))),
      row.names = FALSE)

# ── Forest plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_forest <- ggplot(results, aes(x = Estimate, y = Approach)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#2c3e50") +

  geom_point(aes(fill = Significant),
             size = 4, shape = 21, colour = "white") +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Significant" = "#E74C3C", "NS" = "steelblue"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title    = "Comparison of Causal Estimands (ATT & ATO)",
    subtitle = paste0("Outcome: ", primary_outcome,
                      "  |  Treatment: ", target_treatment,
                      "  |  N = ", nrow(df_final)),
    x        = "Estimated Treatment Effect — VAPFD-28 (days, 95% CI)",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Red = 95% CI excluding 0 | Blue = not significant"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, colour = "#555555"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

print(p_forest)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 6: CAUSAL ML DERIVATION & RANK-BASED SELECTION
# =============================================================================
library(caret)
library(grf)
library(glmnet)
library(dbarts)
library(rlearner)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PIPELINE STEP 6: CROSS-FITTING & CAUSAL ML DERIVATION\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. EMPIRICAL METRICS DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. R-Loss (Squared error of Robinson's transformation)
compute_rloss <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat) {
  loss <- mean(((y - m_hat) - (w - e_hat) * preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(loss)
}

# 2. Empirical Doubly Robust Qini with overlap filter (Crump et al. 2009)
compute_dr_qini <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat, overlap_threshold = 0.05) {
  ok <- abs(w - e_hat) > overlap_threshold
  if (sum(ok) < 20) return(NA_real_)
  
  preds_ok <- preds[ok]
  y_ok     <- y[ok]
  w_ok     <- w[ok]
  m_ok     <- m_hat[ok]
  e_ok     <- e_hat[ok]
  
  pseudo_outcome <- (y_ok - m_ok) / (w_ok - e_ok)
  
  idx <- order(preds_ok, decreasing = TRUE)
  sorted_pseudo <- pseudo_outcome[idx]
  
  cum_gains <- cumsum(sorted_pseudo)
  n <- length(cum_gains)
  
  baseline <- seq(cum_gains[n]/n, cum_gains[n], length.out = n)
  qini_area <- sum(cum_gains - baseline) / n
  
  return(qini_area)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. UNIFIED MATRIX PREPARATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

current_train <- train_final_full
dataset_label <- "Full"

cat(sprintf("\n--- STARTING EVALUATION ON COHORT: %s ---\n", dataset_label))

dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = current_train[, covariates_cleaned])

X_mat <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = current_train[, covariates_cleaned]))

X_valid_cf <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = valid_final_full[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_valid_cf[is.na(X_valid_cf)] <- 0

Y_vec <- current_train[[primary_outcome]]
W_vec <- as.numeric(as.character(current_train[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_vec %in% c(0, 1))) W_vec <- ifelse(W_vec == levels(as.factor(W_vec))[2], 1, 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. CROSS-FITTING OF NUISANCE PARAMETERS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat(" Generating nuisance parameters (m_hat and e_hat) via Cross-Fitting...\n")

set.seed(2026)
cv_folds <- createFolds(Y_vec, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

m_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))
e_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))

df_nuisance <- data.frame(X_mat, Y = Y_vec, W = as.factor(W_vec))

for (i in 1:5) {
  test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(Y_vec), test_idx)
  
  fit_m <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("W")], 
                  num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  m_hat_oof[test_idx] <- predict(fit_m, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  
  fit_e <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                  probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  pred_probs <- predict(fit_e, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  prob_1 <- pred_probs[, which(colnames(pred_probs) == "1")]
  
  e_hat_oof[test_idx] <- pmin(pmax(prob_1, 0.02), 0.98) 
}

fit_e_global <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                       probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
pred_probs_valid <- predict(fit_e_global, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
e_valid_pred <- pred_probs_valid[, which(colnames(pred_probs_valid) == "1")]
e_valid_pred <- pmin(pmax(e_valid_pred, 0.02), 0.98)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CAUSAL ALGORITHMS EVALUATION (5-FOLD CV)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

algorithms <- c("CausalForest", "TLearner_RF", "TianElasticNet", "XBART", "RLasso", "RBoost")
results_matrix <- data.frame()

for (algo in algorithms) {
  cat(" Evaluating algorithm:", algo, "\n")
  fold_rloss <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  fold_qini  <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
    X_tr <- X_mat[-test_idx, ]; Y_tr <- Y_vec[-test_idx]; W_tr <- W_vec[-test_idx]
    X_te <- X_mat[test_idx, ];  Y_te <- Y_vec[test_idx];  W_te <- W_vec[test_idx]
    
    m_te <- m_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_te <- e_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_tr <- e_hat_oof[-test_idx]
    
    result_i <- tryCatch({
      if (algo == "CausalForest") {
        cf <- causal_forest(X_tr, Y_tr, W_tr, W.hat = e_tr, tune.parameters = "all")
        preds_te <- predict(cf, newdata = X_te)$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
        rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 0, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 0]), num.threads = 2)
        rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 1, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 1]), num.threads = 2)
        preds_te <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions - predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
        Z_tian_tr <- (2 * W_tr - 1) * Y_tr
        cv_glm <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, Z_tian_tr, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
        preds_te <- as.numeric(predict(cv_glm, newx = X_te, s = "lambda.min"))
      } 
      else if (algo == "XBART") {
        bart_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], Y_tr[W_tr==1], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        bart_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], Y_tr[W_tr==0], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        D1 <- Y_tr[W_tr==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==1]
        D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==0] - Y_tr[W_tr==0]
        tau_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], D1, x.test = X_te, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        tau_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], D0, x.test = X_te, verbose = FALSE)
        preds_te <- e_te * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_te) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
      } 
      else if (algo == "RLasso") {
        rl_lasso <- rlasso(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_lasso, X_te)
      } 
      else if (algo == "RBoost") {
        rl_boost <- rboost(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr, num_search_rounds = 30)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_boost, X_te)
      }
      
      list(
        rloss = compute_rloss(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te),
        qini  = compute_dr_qini(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Fold ", i, " | ", algo, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
      list(rloss = NA_real_, qini = NA_real_)
    })
    
    fold_rloss[i] <- result_i$rloss
    fold_qini[i]  <- result_i$qini
  }
  
  results_matrix <- rbind(results_matrix, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo,
    Mean_RLoss = mean(fold_rloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Qini = mean(fold_qini, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. NON-PARAMETRIC SELECTION (RANK-BASED BORDA METHOD)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- OVERALL RESULTS AND RANK-BASED SELECTION ---\n")

results_matrix <- results_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_RLoss = rank(Mean_RLoss, ties.method = "average"),
    Rank_Qini  = rank(-Mean_Qini, ties.method = "average"),
    Sum_Ranks  = Rank_RLoss + Rank_Qini
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sum_Ranks, Rank_RLoss)

print(results_matrix %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))))

best_algo <- results_matrix[1, "Algorithm"]

cat(sprintf("\n>>> SELECTED OPTIMAL CONFIGURATION: Algorithm %s <<<\n", best_algo))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. FINAL DERIVATION (STABILITY ACROSS 5 SEEDS)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nInitiating Stability Loop (5 random seeds) for final derivation...\n")

seeds <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)
ite_predictions_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(valid_final_full), ncol = length(seeds))
final_models_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seeds)) {
  cat("   Training iteration", i, "with seed", seeds[i], "...\n")
  set.seed(seeds[i])
  
  if (best_algo == "CausalForest") {
    cf_model <- causal_forest(X_mat, Y_vec, W_vec, W.hat = e_hat_oof, 
                              tune.parameters = "all", seed = seeds[i])
    final_models_list[[i]] <- cf_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(cf_model, newdata = X_valid_cf)$predictions
  } 
  else if (best_algo == "TLearner_RF") {
    rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 0, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 0]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 1, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 1]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(rf_0 = rf_0, rf_1 = rf_1, algo = "TLearner_RF")
    
    pred_0 <- predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    pred_1 <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- pred_1 - pred_0
  }
  else if (best_algo == "TianElasticNet") {
    Z_tian_train <- (2 * W_vec - 1) * Y_vec
    tian_model <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, Z_tian_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- tian_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- as.numeric(predict(tian_model, newx = X_valid_cf, s = "lambda.min"))
  }
  else if (best_algo == "XBART") {
    bart_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], Y_vec[W_vec==1], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    bart_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], Y_vec[W_vec==0], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    D1 <- Y_vec[W_vec==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==1]
    D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==0] - Y_vec[W_vec==0]
    tau_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], D1, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    tau_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], D0, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(tau_1 = tau_1, tau_0 = tau_0, algo = "XBART")
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- e_valid_pred * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_valid_pred) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RLasso") {
    rlasso_model <- rlasso(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rlasso_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rlasso_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RBoost") {
    rboost_model <- rboost(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof, num_search_rounds = 30)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rboost_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rboost_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
}

names(final_models_list) <- paste0("seed_", seeds)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G. SAVING PROJECTION ON EXTERNAL VALIDATION SET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
valid_final_full$ITE_stabilized <- rowMeans(ite_predictions_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

file_name_data <- sprintf("Valid_%s_with_ITE_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)
file_name_models <- sprintf("Models_%s_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)

saveRDS(valid_final_full, file = file_name_data)
saveRDS(final_models_list, file = file_name_models)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving completed for %s cohort.\n", dataset_label))
cat("Generated files:", file_name_data, "and", file_name_models, "\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. RATE with AUTOC weighting

autoc_est <- rate_autoc$estimate

autoc_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(autoc_est / autoc_se))

# =============================================================================
# C. C-FOR-BENEFIT (van Klaveren concordance)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- C. C-for-benefit (van Klaveren et al. 2018) ---\n")

compute_c_for_benefit <- function(preds, y, w, max_pairs = 400, n_iter = 50) {
  idx_1 <- which(w == 1)
  idx_0 <- which(w == 0)
  n_pairs <- min(length(idx_1), length(idx_0), max_pairs)
  
  if (n_pairs < 20) return(list(c_stat = NA_real_, n_pairs = n_pairs))
  c_indices <- numeric(n_iter)
  
  set.seed(2026)
  for (k in 1:n_iter) {
    m1 <- sample(idx_1, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    m0 <- sample(idx_0, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    
    obs_ben  <- y[m1] - y[m0]
    pred_ben <- (preds[m1] + preds[m0]) / 2
    
    pd <- outer(pred_ben, pred_ben, "-")
    od <- outer(obs_ben,  obs_ben,  "-")
    ut <- upper.tri(pd)
    pd_v <- pd[ut]; od_v <- od[ut]
    
    non_tied <- abs(pd_v) > .Machine$double.eps
    pd_v <- pd_v[non_tied]; od_v <- od_v[non_tied]
    
    conc <- sum(sign(pd_v) == sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    disc <- sum(sign(pd_v) != sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    tot  <- conc + disc
    c_indices[k] <- if (tot == 0) 0.5 else conc / tot
  }
  
  list(
    c_stat = mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lo = quantile(c_indices, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_hi = quantile(c_indices, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n_pairs
  )
}

cfb_res <- compute_c_for_benefit(valid_final$ITE_stabilized, Y_val, W_val)
cat(sprintf("C-for-benefit: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f)\n", 
            cfb_res$c_stat, cfb_res$ci_lo, cfb_res$ci_hi))

# D. INTERACTION TEST (Likelihood Ratio Test)

cat("\n--- D. Interaction Test (Treatment * Tertile) ---\n")

valid_final$W_num <- W_val
base_mod <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num + ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())
int_mod  <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())

lrt_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "LRT")
p_val_interaction <- lrt_test$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

# F-test is required for a Gaussian model (estimated variance)

f_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "F")
p_val_int <- f_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]

cat(" Interaction (F-Test) p-value:", format.pval(p_val_int, digits = 3), "\n")


# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: NON-PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP (R=500)

cat("\n3. Sensitivity Analysis: Bootstrap for Continuous Outcomes (R=500)...\n")
library(boot)

# Function to extract interaction coefficient
boot_interaction_coef <- function(data, indices, outcome_name) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  form_int  <- as.formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label"))
  fit_int  <- lm(form_int, data = d)
  
  # Specific extraction of interaction coefficient(s)
  coefs <- coef(fit_int)
  int_coefs <- coefs[grep("W_num:ITE_tertile_label", names(coefs))]
  
  # Returns the coefficient(s) (1 if numeric, 2 if factor; boot() handles multiple values)
  return(int_coefs)
}

# Run bootstrap for VAPFD_28

# E. CALIBRATION BY TERTILE (MULTIPLE OUTCOMES WITH BOOTSTRAP CI)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- E. Out-of-Sample Calibration by Tertiles (Clinical Dimensions) ---\n")

# Robust function to compute ARD and its bootstrap confidence intervals
compute_ard_with_ci <- function(Y, W, n_boot = 1000) {
  n <- length(Y)
  ard_obs <- mean(Y[W == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[W == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  boot_ard <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  list(
    ARD = ard_obs,
    CI_Lo = quantile(boot_ard, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Hi = quantile(boot_ard, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

set.seed(2026)
calibration_results <- valid_final %>%
  group_by(ITE_tertile_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    # 1. Infectious Dimension (Dynamic primary outcome)
    ard_prim <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[[primary_outcome]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 2. Safety Dimension (28-day mortality)
    ard_mort <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["mortality_28d"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 3. Respiratory Dimension (Ventilator-free days)
    ard_vfd <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["VFD_28"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    data.frame(
      N_patients = nrow(.x),
      Mean_Predicted_ITE = mean(.x$ITE_stabilized, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ARD_Primary = ard_prim$ARD,
      Primary_CI_Lo = ard_prim$CI_Lo,
      Primary_CI_Hi = ard_prim$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_Mortality = ard_mort$ARD,
      Mortality_CI_Lo = ard_mort$CI_Lo,
      Mortality_CI_Hi = ard_mort$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_VFD_28 = ard_vfd$ARD,
      VFD_CI_Lo = ard_vfd$CI_Lo,
      VFD_CI_Hi = ard_vfd$CI_Hi
    )
  }) %>% ungroup()

print(calibration_results, digits = 3)

# =============================================================================
# F. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Aggregated across the 5 models)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- F. Variable Importance Extraction (Aggregated) ---\n")

# Robust extraction function with NULL-safety checks
extract_variable_importance <- function(model, algo, X_colnames) {
  tryCatch({
    if (algo == "CausalForest") {
      vi <- grf::variable_importance(model)
      feats <- X_colnames
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
      vi_0 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_0)
      vi_1 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_1)
      vi_mean <- (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2
      feats <- names(vi_mean)
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_mean))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi_mean), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
      lambda_use <- tryCatch(model$lambda.min, error = function(e) model$lambda[1])
      coefs <- coef(model, s = lambda_use)
      feats <- rownames(coefs)[-1]
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", 1:(nrow(coefs)-1))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = abs(as.numeric(coefs)[-1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "XBART") {
      if (!is.null(model$tau_0$varcount) & !is.null(model$tau_1$varcount)) {
        vi_0 <- colMeans(model$tau_0$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        vi_1 <- colMeans(model$tau_1$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        feats <- X_colnames
        if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_0))
        out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else { stop("XBART object missing varcount.") }
      
    } else if (algo == "RLasso") {
      tau_beta <- model$tau_beta

      if (length(tau_beta) == length(X_colnames) + 1) {
        tau_beta <- tau_beta[-1]
      }

      if (length(tau_beta) != length(X_colnames)) {
        glmnet_obj <- model$tau_fit
        lam        <- glmnet_obj$lambda.min
        coefs      <- coef(glmnet_obj, s = lam)
        coef_vals  <- as.numeric(coefs)[-1]

        n_feats  <- min(length(coef_vals), length(X_colnames))
        tau_beta <- coef_vals[seq_len(n_feats)]
        X_colnames <- X_colnames[seq_len(n_feats)]
      }

      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = X_colnames,
        Importance = abs(tau_beta),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
    } else if (algo == "RBoost") {
      xgb_obj <- model$tau_fit$xgb_fit

      if (is.null(xgb_obj) || !inherits(xgb_obj, "xgb.Booster")) {
        stop("xgb_fit is not an xgb.Booster object")
      }

      vi <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = xgb_obj)
      feats <- vi$Feature
      
      # Restore clinical variable names
      if (all(grepl("^f[0-9]+$", feats))) {
        idx <- as.numeric(sub("^f", "", feats)) + 1 
        if (!is.null(X_colnames) && max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) <= length(X_colnames)) {
          feats <- X_colnames[idx]
        }
      }
      
      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = feats,
        Importance = vi$Gain,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    out %>% filter(!is.na(Importance))

  }, error = function(e) { 
    warning(paste("Error extracting variable importance:", conditionMessage(e)))
    return(NULL) 
  })
}

# Extraction and averaging across the 5 seeds
liste_importances <- lapply(final_models_list, function(modele_iter) {
  extract_variable_importance(model = modele_iter, algo = best_algo, X_colnames = colnames(X_mat))
})

# Execution safety check
if (all(sapply(liste_importances, is.null))) {
  stop("Critical failure: Unable to extract variable importance across all models.")
}

importance_df <- bind_rows(liste_importances) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(Importance = mean(Importance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  mutate(Importance = Importance / max(Importance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  head(20)

print(head(importance_df, 10), digits = 3)

imp_plot <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Feature, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2980B9", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Importance, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = paste0("Variable Importance (Aggregated) — ", best_algo), x = "Relative Importance", y = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

print(imp_plot)

# =============================================================================
# G. TABLE 1 BY ITE TERTILE
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- G. Generating Table 1 Stratified by Tertile ---\n")

if(!exists("covariates_X")) covariates_X <- covariates_cleaned

table1_tertiles <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = covariates_X, 
  strata = "ITE_tertile_label", 
  data = valid_final, 
  test = TRUE
)
table1_tertiles
```
