```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 6: CAUSAL ML DERIVATION & RANK-BASED SELECTION
# =============================================================================
library(caret)
library(grf)
library(glmnet)
library(dbarts)
library(rlearner)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PIPELINE STEP 6: CROSS-FITTING & CAUSAL ML DERIVATION\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. EMPIRICAL METRICS DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. R-Loss (Squared error of Robinson's transformation)
compute_rloss <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat) {
  loss <- mean(((y - m_hat) - (w - e_hat) * preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(loss)
}

# 2. Empirical Doubly Robust Qini with overlap filter (Crump et al. 2009)
compute_dr_qini <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat, overlap_threshold = 0.05) {
  ok <- abs(w - e_hat) > overlap_threshold
  if (sum(ok) < 20) return(NA_real_)
  
  preds_ok <- preds[ok]
  y_ok     <- y[ok]
  w_ok     <- w[ok]
  m_ok     <- m_hat[ok]
  e_ok     <- e_hat[ok]
  
  pseudo_outcome <- (y_ok - m_ok) / (w_ok - e_ok)
  
  idx <- order(preds_ok, decreasing = TRUE)
  sorted_pseudo <- pseudo_outcome[idx]
  
  cum_gains <- cumsum(sorted_pseudo)
  n <- length(cum_gains)
  
  baseline <- seq(cum_gains[n]/n, cum_gains[n], length.out = n)
  qini_area <- sum(cum_gains - baseline) / n
  
  return(qini_area)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. UNIFIED MATRIX PREPARATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

current_train <- train_final_025
dataset_label <- "2.5_97.5"

cat(sprintf("\n--- STARTING EVALUATION ON COHORT: %s ---\n", dataset_label))

dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = current_train[, covariates_cleaned])

X_mat <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = current_train[, covariates_cleaned]))

X_valid_cf <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = valid_final_full[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_valid_cf[is.na(X_valid_cf)] <- 0

Y_vec <- current_train[[primary_outcome]]
W_vec <- as.numeric(as.character(current_train[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_vec %in% c(0, 1))) W_vec <- ifelse(W_vec == levels(as.factor(W_vec))[2], 1, 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. CROSS-FITTING OF NUISANCE PARAMETERS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat(" Generating nuisance parameters (m_hat and e_hat) via Cross-Fitting...\n")

set.seed(2026)
cv_folds <- createFolds(Y_vec, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

m_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))
e_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))

df_nuisance <- data.frame(X_mat, Y = Y_vec, W = as.factor(W_vec))

for (i in 1:5) {
  test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(Y_vec), test_idx)
  
  fit_m <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("W")], 
                  num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  m_hat_oof[test_idx] <- predict(fit_m, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  
  fit_e <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                  probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  pred_probs <- predict(fit_e, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  prob_1 <- pred_probs[, which(colnames(pred_probs) == "1")]
  
  e_hat_oof[test_idx] <- pmin(pmax(prob_1, 0.02), 0.98) 
}

fit_e_global <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                       probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
pred_probs_valid <- predict(fit_e_global, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
e_valid_pred <- pred_probs_valid[, which(colnames(pred_probs_valid) == "1")]
e_valid_pred <- pmin(pmax(e_valid_pred, 0.02), 0.98)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CAUSAL ALGORITHMS EVALUATION (5-FOLD CV)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

algorithms <- c("CausalForest", "TLearner_RF", "TianElasticNet", "XBART", "RLasso", "RBoost")
results_matrix <- data.frame()

for (algo in algorithms) {
  cat(" Evaluating algorithm:", algo, "\n")
  fold_rloss <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  fold_qini  <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
    X_tr <- X_mat[-test_idx, ]; Y_tr <- Y_vec[-test_idx]; W_tr <- W_vec[-test_idx]
    X_te <- X_mat[test_idx, ];  Y_te <- Y_vec[test_idx];  W_te <- W_vec[test_idx]
    
    m_te <- m_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_te <- e_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_tr <- e_hat_oof[-test_idx]
    
    result_i <- tryCatch({
      if (algo == "CausalForest") {
        cf <- causal_forest(X_tr, Y_tr, W_tr, W.hat = e_tr, tune.parameters = "all")
        preds_te <- predict(cf, newdata = X_te)$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
        rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 0, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 0]), num.threads = 2)
        rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 1, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 1]), num.threads = 2)
        preds_te <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions - predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
        Z_tian_tr <- (2 * W_tr - 1) * Y_tr
        cv_glm <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, Z_tian_tr, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
        preds_te <- as.numeric(predict(cv_glm, newx = X_te, s = "lambda.min"))
      } 
      else if (algo == "XBART") {
        bart_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], Y_tr[W_tr==1], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        bart_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], Y_tr[W_tr==0], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        D1 <- Y_tr[W_tr==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==1]
        D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==0] - Y_tr[W_tr==0]
        tau_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], D1, x.test = X_te, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        tau_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], D0, x.test = X_te, verbose = FALSE)
        preds_te <- e_te * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_te) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
      } 
      else if (algo == "RLasso") {
        rl_lasso <- rlasso(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_lasso, X_te)
      } 
      else if (algo == "RBoost") {
        rl_boost <- rboost(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr, num_search_rounds = 30)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_boost, X_te)
      }
      
      list(
        rloss = compute_rloss(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te),
        qini  = compute_dr_qini(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Fold ", i, " | ", algo, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
      list(rloss = NA_real_, qini = NA_real_)
    })
    
    fold_rloss[i] <- result_i$rloss
    fold_qini[i]  <- result_i$qini
  }
  
  results_matrix <- rbind(results_matrix, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo,
    Mean_RLoss = mean(fold_rloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Qini = mean(fold_qini, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. NON-PARAMETRIC SELECTION (RANK-BASED BORDA METHOD)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- OVERALL RESULTS AND RANK-BASED SELECTION ---\n")

results_matrix <- results_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_RLoss = rank(Mean_RLoss, ties.method = "average"),
    Rank_Qini  = rank(-Mean_Qini, ties.method = "average"),
    Sum_Ranks  = Rank_RLoss + Rank_Qini
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sum_Ranks, Rank_RLoss)

print(results_matrix %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))))

best_algo <- results_matrix[1, "Algorithm"]

cat(sprintf("\n>>> SELECTED OPTIMAL CONFIGURATION: Algorithm %s <<<\n", best_algo))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. FINAL DERIVATION (STABILITY ACROSS 5 SEEDS)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nInitiating Stability Loop (5 random seeds) for final derivation...\n")

seeds <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)
ite_predictions_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(valid_final_full), ncol = length(seeds))
final_models_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seeds)) {
  cat("   Training iteration", i, "with seed", seeds[i], "...\n")
  set.seed(seeds[i])
  
  if (best_algo == "CausalForest") {
    cf_model <- causal_forest(X_mat, Y_vec, W_vec, W.hat = e_hat_oof, 
                              tune.parameters = "all", seed = seeds[i])
    final_models_list[[i]] <- cf_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(cf_model, newdata = X_valid_cf)$predictions
  } 
  else if (best_algo == "TLearner_RF") {
    rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 0, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 0]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 1, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 1]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(rf_0 = rf_0, rf_1 = rf_1, algo = "TLearner_RF")
    
    pred_0 <- predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    pred_1 <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- pred_1 - pred_0
  }
  else if (best_algo == "TianElasticNet") {
    Z_tian_train <- (2 * W_vec - 1) * Y_vec
    tian_model <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, Z_tian_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- tian_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- as.numeric(predict(tian_model, newx = X_valid_cf, s = "lambda.min"))
  }
  else if (best_algo == "XBART") {
    bart_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], Y_vec[W_vec==1], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    bart_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], Y_vec[W_vec==0], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    D1 <- Y_vec[W_vec==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==1]
    D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==0] - Y_vec[W_vec==0]
    tau_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], D1, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    tau_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], D0, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(tau_1 = tau_1, tau_0 = tau_0, algo = "XBART")
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- e_valid_pred * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_valid_pred) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RLasso") {
    rlasso_model <- rlasso(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rlasso_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rlasso_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RBoost") {
    rboost_model <- rboost(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof, num_search_rounds = 30)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rboost_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rboost_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
}

names(final_models_list) <- paste0("seed_", seeds)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G. SAVING PROJECTION ON EXTERNAL VALIDATION SET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
valid_final_full$ITE_stabilized <- rowMeans(ite_predictions_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

file_name_data <- sprintf("Valid_%s_with_ITE_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)
file_name_models <- sprintf("Models_%s_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)

saveRDS(valid_final_full, file = file_name_data)
saveRDS(final_models_list, file = file_name_models)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving completed for %s cohort.\n", dataset_label))
cat("Generated files:", file_name_data, "and", file_name_models, "\n")

```




```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 7: PERFORMANCE EVALUATION & CLINICAL UTILITY
# =============================================================================
# Required dependencies
library(grf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tableone)
library(survival)
library(pracma)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  SECTION 7 — PERFORMANCE EVALUATION & CLINICAL UTILITY\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# Create output directories
#dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
#dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/tables",  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# A. TERTILE STRATIFICATION (T-Learner / Stabilized ITE)
# =============================================================================
cat("--- A. Benefit tertile stratification ---\n")

valid_final <- readRDS("Valid_2.5_97.5_with_ITE_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")

final_models_list <- readRDS("Models_2.5_97.5_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")

valid_final <- valid_final %>%
  mutate(
    ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3),
    ITE_tertile_label = factor(
      ITE_tertile, 
      levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
      labels = c("1: Low Benefit", "2: Moderate Benefit", "3: High Benefit")
    )
  )

Y_val <- as.numeric(valid_final[[primary_outcome]])
W_val <- as.numeric(as.character(valid_final[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_val %in% c(0, 1))) W_val <- ifelse(W_val == levels(as.factor(W_val))[2], 1, 0)
PS_val <- valid_final$PS


# =============================================================================
# B. GLOBAL DISCRIMINATION (RATE Framework: AUTOC & Qini)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- B. Global Causal Discrimination (RATE framework) ---\n")

dummy_eval <- dummyVars(~ ., data = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned])
X_val_numeric <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_eval, newdata = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_val_numeric[is.na(X_val_numeric)] <- 0

set.seed(2026)
evaluation_forest <- causal_forest(
  X = X_val_numeric, 
  Y = Y_val, 
  W = W_val, 
  W.hat = PS_val, 
  num.trees = 2000,
  seed = 2026
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. RATE with AUTOC weighting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rate_autoc <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
  evaluation_forest, 
  valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
  target = "AUTOC"
)

autoc_est <- rate_autoc$estimate
autoc_se <- rate_autoc$std.err
autoc_ci_lo <- autoc_est - 1.96 * autoc_se
autoc_ci_hi <- autoc_est + 1.96 * autoc_se
autoc_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(autoc_est / autoc_se))

cat("1. RATE (Target = AUTOC)\n")
cat(sprintf("   Estimate : %.3f\n", autoc_est))
cat(sprintf("   SE       : %.3f\n", autoc_se))
cat(sprintf("   95%% CI   : [%.3f ; %.3f]\n", autoc_ci_lo, autoc_ci_hi))
cat(sprintf("   p-value  : %s\n\n", format.pval(autoc_pval, digits = 3)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RATE with Qini weighting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rate_qini <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
  evaluation_forest, 
  valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
  target = "QINI"
)

qini_est <- rate_qini$estimate
qini_se <- rate_qini$std.err
qini_ci_lo <- qini_est - 1.96 * qini_se
qini_ci_hi <- qini_est + 1.96 * qini_se
qini_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(qini_est / qini_se))

cat("2. RATE (Target = Qini)\n")
cat(sprintf("   Estimate : %.3f\n", qini_est))
cat(sprintf("   SE       : %.3f\n", qini_se))
cat(sprintf("   95%% CI   : [%.3f ; %.3f]\n", qini_ci_lo, qini_ci_hi))
cat(sprintf("   p-value  : %s\n", format.pval(qini_pval, digits = 3)))
# =============================================================================
# C. C-FOR-BENEFIT (van Klaveren concordance)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- C. C-for-benefit (van Klaveren et al. 2018) ---\n")

compute_c_for_benefit <- function(preds, y, w, max_pairs = 400, n_iter = 50) {
  idx_1 <- which(w == 1)
  idx_0 <- which(w == 0)
  n_pairs <- min(length(idx_1), length(idx_0), max_pairs)
  
  if (n_pairs < 20) return(list(c_stat = NA_real_, n_pairs = n_pairs))
  c_indices <- numeric(n_iter)
  
  set.seed(2026)
  for (k in 1:n_iter) {
    m1 <- sample(idx_1, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    m0 <- sample(idx_0, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    
    obs_ben  <- y[m1] - y[m0]
    pred_ben <- (preds[m1] + preds[m0]) / 2
    
    pd <- outer(pred_ben, pred_ben, "-")
    od <- outer(obs_ben,  obs_ben,  "-")
    ut <- upper.tri(pd)
    pd_v <- pd[ut]; od_v <- od[ut]
    
    non_tied <- abs(pd_v) > .Machine$double.eps
    pd_v <- pd_v[non_tied]; od_v <- od_v[non_tied]
    
    conc <- sum(sign(pd_v) == sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    disc <- sum(sign(pd_v) != sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    tot  <- conc + disc
    c_indices[k] <- if (tot == 0) 0.5 else conc / tot
  }
  
  list(
    c_stat = mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lo = quantile(c_indices, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_hi = quantile(c_indices, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n_pairs
  )
}

cfb_res <- compute_c_for_benefit(valid_final$ITE_stabilized, Y_val, W_val)
cat(sprintf("C-for-benefit: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f)\n", 
            cfb_res$c_stat, cfb_res$ci_lo, cfb_res$ci_hi))

# =============================================================================
# D. INTERACTION TEST (Likelihood Ratio Test)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- D. Interaction Test (Treatment * Tertile) ---\n")

valid_final$W_num <- W_val
base_mod <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num + ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())
int_mod  <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())

lrt_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "LRT")
p_val_interaction <- lrt_test$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

# F-test is required for a Gaussian model (estimated variance)

f_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "F")
p_val_int <- f_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]

cat(" Interaction (F-Test) p-value:", format.pval(p_val_int, digits = 3), "\n")


# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: NON-PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP (R=500)

cat("\n3. Sensitivity Analysis: Bootstrap for Continuous Outcomes (R=500)...\n")
library(boot)

# Function to extract interaction coefficient
boot_interaction_coef <- function(data, indices, outcome_name) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  form_int  <- as.formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label"))
  fit_int  <- lm(form_int, data = d)
  
  # Specific extraction of interaction coefficient(s)
  coefs <- coef(fit_int)
  int_coefs <- coefs[grep("W_num:ITE_tertile_label", names(coefs))]
  
  # Returns the coefficient(s) (1 if numeric, 2 if factor; boot() handles multiple values)
  return(int_coefs)
}

# Run bootstrap for VAPFD_28
set.seed(2026)
boot_lrt<- boot(data = valid_final, statistic = boot_interaction_coef, R = 500, outcome_name = "VAPFD_28")


cat("Bootstrap completed.\n\n")

# E. CALIBRATION BY TERTILE (MULTIPLE OUTCOMES WITH BOOTSTRAP CI)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- E. Out-of-Sample Calibration by Tertiles (Clinical Dimensions) ---\n")

# Robust function to compute ARD and its bootstrap confidence intervals
compute_ard_with_ci <- function(Y, W, n_boot = 1000) {
  n <- length(Y)
  ard_obs <- mean(Y[W == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[W == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  boot_ard <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  list(
    ARD = ard_obs,
    CI_Lo = quantile(boot_ard, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Hi = quantile(boot_ard, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

set.seed(2026)
calibration_results <- valid_final %>%
  group_by(ITE_tertile_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    # 1. Infectious Dimension (Dynamic primary outcome)
    ard_prim <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[[primary_outcome]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 2. Safety Dimension (28-day mortality)
    ard_mort <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["mortality_28d"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 3. Respiratory Dimension (Ventilator-free days)
    ard_vfd <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["VFD_28"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    data.frame(
      N_patients = nrow(.x),
      Mean_Predicted_ITE = mean(.x$ITE_stabilized, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ARD_Primary = ard_prim$ARD,
      Primary_CI_Lo = ard_prim$CI_Lo,
      Primary_CI_Hi = ard_prim$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_Mortality = ard_mort$ARD,
      Mortality_CI_Lo = ard_mort$CI_Lo,
      Mortality_CI_Hi = ard_mort$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_VFD_28 = ard_vfd$ARD,
      VFD_CI_Lo = ard_vfd$CI_Lo,
      VFD_CI_Hi = ard_vfd$CI_Hi
    )
  }) %>% ungroup()

print(calibration_results, digits = 3)

# F. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Aggregated across the 5 models)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- F. Variable Importance Extraction (Aggregated) ---\n")

# Robust extraction function with NULL-safety checks
extract_variable_importance <- function(model, algo, X_colnames) {
  tryCatch({
    if (algo == "CausalForest") {
      vi <- grf::variable_importance(model)
      feats <- X_colnames
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
      vi_0 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_0)
      vi_1 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_1)
      vi_mean <- (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2
      feats <- names(vi_mean)
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_mean))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi_mean), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
      lambda_use <- tryCatch(model$lambda.min, error = function(e) model$lambda[1])
      coefs <- coef(model, s = lambda_use)
      feats <- rownames(coefs)[-1]
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", 1:(nrow(coefs)-1))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = abs(as.numeric(coefs)[-1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "XBART") {
      if (!is.null(model$tau_0$varcount) & !is.null(model$tau_1$varcount)) {
        vi_0 <- colMeans(model$tau_0$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        vi_1 <- colMeans(model$tau_1$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        feats <- X_colnames
        if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_0))
        out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else { stop("XBART object missing varcount.") }
      
    } else if (algo == "RLasso") {
      tau_beta <- model$tau_beta

      if (length(tau_beta) == length(X_colnames) + 1) {
        tau_beta <- tau_beta[-1]
      }

      if (length(tau_beta) != length(X_colnames)) {
        glmnet_obj <- model$tau_fit
        lam        <- glmnet_obj$lambda.min
        coefs      <- coef(glmnet_obj, s = lam)
        coef_vals  <- as.numeric(coefs)[-1]

        n_feats  <- min(length(coef_vals), length(X_colnames))
        tau_beta <- coef_vals[seq_len(n_feats)]
        X_colnames <- X_colnames[seq_len(n_feats)]
      }

      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = X_colnames,
        Importance = abs(tau_beta),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
    } else if (algo == "RBoost") {
      xgb_obj <- model$tau_fit$xgb_fit

      if (is.null(xgb_obj) || !inherits(xgb_obj, "xgb.Booster")) {
        stop("xgb_fit is not an xgb.Booster object")
      }

      vi <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = xgb_obj)
      feats <- vi$Feature
      
      # Restore clinical variable names
      if (all(grepl("^f[0-9]+$", feats))) {
        idx <- as.numeric(sub("^f", "", feats)) + 1 
        if (!is.null(X_colnames) && max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) <= length(X_colnames)) {
          feats <- X_colnames[idx]
        }
      }
      
      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = feats,
        Importance = vi$Gain,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    out %>% filter(!is.na(Importance))

  }, error = function(e) { 
    warning(paste("Error extracting variable importance:", conditionMessage(e)))
    return(NULL) 
  })
}

# Extraction and averaging across the 5 seeds
liste_importances <- lapply(final_models_list, function(modele_iter) {
  extract_variable_importance(model = modele_iter, algo = best_algo, X_colnames = colnames(X_mat))
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 6: CAUSAL ML DERIVATION & RANK-BASED SELECTION
# =============================================================================
library(caret)
library(grf)
library(glmnet)
library(dbarts)
library(rlearner)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PIPELINE STEP 6: CROSS-FITTING & CAUSAL ML DERIVATION\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. EMPIRICAL METRICS DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. R-Loss (Squared error of Robinson's transformation)
compute_rloss <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat) {
  loss <- mean(((y - m_hat) - (w - e_hat) * preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(loss)
}

# 2. Empirical Doubly Robust Qini with overlap filter (Crump et al. 2009)
compute_dr_qini <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat, overlap_threshold = 0.05) {
  ok <- abs(w - e_hat) > overlap_threshold
  if (sum(ok) < 20) return(NA_real_)
  
  preds_ok <- preds[ok]
  y_ok     <- y[ok]
  w_ok     <- w[ok]
  m_ok     <- m_hat[ok]
  e_ok     <- e_hat[ok]
  
  pseudo_outcome <- (y_ok - m_ok) / (w_ok - e_ok)
  
  idx <- order(preds_ok, decreasing = TRUE)
  sorted_pseudo <- pseudo_outcome[idx]
  
  cum_gains <- cumsum(sorted_pseudo)
  n <- length(cum_gains)
  
  baseline <- seq(cum_gains[n]/n, cum_gains[n], length.out = n)
  qini_area <- sum(cum_gains - baseline) / n
  
  return(qini_area)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. UNIFIED MATRIX PREPARATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

current_train <- train_final_05
dataset_label <- "5-95"

X_valid_cf[is.na(X_valid_cf)] <- 0

Y_vec <- current_train[[primary_outcome]]
W_vec <- as.numeric(as.character(current_train[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_vec %in% c(0, 1))) W_vec <- ifelse(W_vec == levels(as.factor(W_vec))[2], 1, 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. CROSS-FITTING OF NUISANCE PARAMETERS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat(" Generating nuisance parameters (m_hat and e_hat) via Cross-Fitting...\n")

set.seed(2026)
cv_folds <- createFolds(Y_vec, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

m_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))
e_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))

df_nuisance <- data.frame(X_mat, Y = Y_vec, W = as.factor(W_vec))

for (i in 1:5) {
  test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(Y_vec), test_idx)
  
  fit_m <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("W")], 
                  num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  m_hat_oof[test_idx] <- predict(fit_m, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  
  fit_e <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                  probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  pred_probs <- predict(fit_e, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  prob_1 <- pred_probs[, which(colnames(pred_probs) == "1")]
  
  e_hat_oof[test_idx] <- pmin(pmax(prob_1, 0.02), 0.98) 
}

fit_e_global <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                       probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
pred_probs_valid <- predict(fit_e_global, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
e_valid_pred <- pred_probs_valid[, which(colnames(pred_probs_valid) == "1")]
e_valid_pred <- pmin(pmax(e_valid_pred, 0.02), 0.98)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CAUSAL ALGORITHMS EVALUATION (5-FOLD CV)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

algorithms <- c("CausalForest", "TLearner_RF", "TianElasticNet", "XBART", "RLasso", "RBoost")
results_matrix <- data.frame()

for (algo in algorithms) {
  cat(" Evaluating algorithm:", algo, "\n")
  fold_rloss <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  fold_qini  <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
    X_tr <- X_mat[-test_idx, ]; Y_tr <- Y_vec[-test_idx]; W_tr <- W_vec[-test_idx]
    X_te <- X_mat[test_idx, ];  Y_te <- Y_vec[test_idx];  W_te <- W_vec[test_idx]
    
    m_te <- m_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_te <- e_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_tr <- e_hat_oof[-test_idx]
    
    result_i <- tryCatch({
      if (algo == "CausalForest") {
        cf <- causal_forest(X_tr, Y_tr, W_tr, W.hat = e_tr, tune.parameters = "all")
        preds_te <- predict(cf, newdata = X_te)$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
        rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 0, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 0]), num.threads = 2)
        rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 1, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 1]), num.threads = 2)
        preds_te <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions - predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
        Z_tian_tr <- (2 * W_tr - 1) * Y_tr
        cv_glm <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, Z_tian_tr, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
        preds_te <- as.numeric(predict(cv_glm, newx = X_te, s = "lambda.min"))
      } 
      else if (algo == "XBART") {
        bart_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], Y_tr[W_tr==1], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        bart_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], Y_tr[W_tr==0], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        D1 <- Y_tr[W_tr==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==1]
        D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==0] - Y_tr[W_tr==0]
        tau_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], D1, x.test = X_te, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        tau_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], D0, x.test = X_te, verbose = FALSE)
        preds_te <- e_te * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_te) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
      } 
      else if (algo == "RLasso") {
        rl_lasso <- rlasso(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_lasso, X_te)
      } 
      else if (algo == "RBoost") {
        rl_boost <- rboost(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr, num_search_rounds = 30)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_boost, X_te)
      }
      
      list(
        rloss = compute_rloss(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te),
        qini  = compute_dr_qini(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Fold ", i, " | ", algo, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
      list(rloss = NA_real_, qini = NA_real_)
    })
    
    fold_rloss[i] <- result_i$rloss
    fold_qini[i]  <- result_i$qini
  }
  
  results_matrix <- rbind(results_matrix, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo,
    Mean_RLoss = mean(fold_rloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Qini = mean(fold_qini, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. NON-PARAMETRIC SELECTION (RANK-BASED BORDA METHOD)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- OVERALL RESULTS AND RANK-BASED SELECTION ---\n")

results_matrix <- results_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_RLoss = rank(Mean_RLoss, ties.method = "average"),
    Rank_Qini  = rank(-Mean_Qini, ties.method = "average"),
    Sum_Ranks  = Rank_RLoss + Rank_Qini
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sum_Ranks, Rank_RLoss)

print(results_matrix %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))))

best_algo <- results_matrix[1, "Algorithm"]

cat(sprintf("\n>>> SELECTED OPTIMAL CONFIGURATION: Algorithm %s <<<\n", best_algo))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. FINAL DERIVATION (STABILITY ACROSS 5 SEEDS)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nInitiating Stability Loop (5 random seeds) for final derivation...\n")

seeds <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)
ite_predictions_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(valid_final_full), ncol = length(seeds))
final_models_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seeds)) {
  cat("   Training iteration", i, "with seed", seeds[i], "...\n")
  set.seed(seeds[i])
  
  if (best_algo == "CausalForest") {
    cf_model <- causal_forest(X_mat, Y_vec, W_vec, W.hat = e_hat_oof, 
                              tune.parameters = "all", seed = seeds[i])
    final_models_list[[i]] <- cf_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(cf_model, newdata = X_valid_cf)$predictions
  } 
  else if (best_algo == "TLearner_RF") {
    rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 0, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 0]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 1, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 1]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(rf_0 = rf_0, rf_1 = rf_1, algo = "TLearner_RF")
    
    pred_0 <- predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    pred_1 <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- pred_1 - pred_0
  }
  else if (best_algo == "TianElasticNet") {
    Z_tian_train <- (2 * W_vec - 1) * Y_vec
    tian_model <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, Z_tian_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- tian_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- as.numeric(predict(tian_model, newx = X_valid_cf, s = "lambda.min"))
  }
  else if (best_algo == "XBART") {
    bart_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], Y_vec[W_vec==1], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    bart_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], Y_vec[W_vec==0], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    D1 <- Y_vec[W_vec==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==1]
    D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==0] - Y_vec[W_vec==0]
    tau_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], D1, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    tau_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], D0, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(tau_1 = tau_1, tau_0 = tau_0, algo = "XBART")
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- e_valid_pred * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_valid_pred) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RLasso") {
    rlasso_model <- rlasso(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rlasso_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rlasso_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RBoost") {
    rboost_model <- rboost(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof, num_search_rounds = 30)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rboost_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rboost_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
}

names(final_models_list) <- paste0("seed_", seeds)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G. SAVING PROJECTION ON EXTERNAL VALIDATION SET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
valid_final_full$ITE_stabilized <- rowMeans(ite_predictions_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

file_name_data <- sprintf("Valid_%s_with_ITE_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)
file_name_models <- sprintf("Models_%s_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)

saveRDS(valid_final_full, file = file_name_data)
saveRDS(final_models_list, file = file_name_models)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving completed for %s cohort.\n", dataset_label))
cat("Generated files:", file_name_data, "and", file_name_models, "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# C. C-FOR-BENEFIT (van Klaveren concordance)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- C. C-for-benefit (van Klaveren et al. 2018) ---\n")

compute_c_for_benefit <- function(preds, y, w, max_pairs = 400, n_iter = 50) {
  idx_1 <- which(w == 1)
  idx_0 <- which(w == 0)
  n_pairs <- min(length(idx_1), length(idx_0), max_pairs)
  
  if (n_pairs < 20) return(list(c_stat = NA_real_, n_pairs = n_pairs))
  c_indices <- numeric(n_iter)
  
  set.seed(2026)
  for (k in 1:n_iter) {
    m1 <- sample(idx_1, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    m0 <- sample(idx_0, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    
    obs_ben  <- y[m1] - y[m0]
    pred_ben <- (preds[m1] + preds[m0]) / 2
    
    pd <- outer(pred_ben, pred_ben, "-")
    od <- outer(obs_ben,  obs_ben,  "-")
    ut <- upper.tri(pd)
    pd_v <- pd[ut]; od_v <- od[ut]
    
    non_tied <- abs(pd_v) > .Machine$double.eps
    pd_v <- pd_v[non_tied]; od_v <- od_v[non_tied]
    
    conc <- sum(sign(pd_v) == sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    disc <- sum(sign(pd_v) != sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    tot  <- conc + disc
    c_indices[k] <- if (tot == 0) 0.5 else conc / tot
  }
  
  list(
    c_stat = mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lo = quantile(c_indices, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_hi = quantile(c_indices, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n_pairs
  )
}

cfb_res <- compute_c_for_benefit(valid_final$ITE_stabilized, Y_val, W_val)
cat(sprintf("C-for-benefit: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f)\n", 
            cfb_res$c_stat, cfb_res$ci_lo, cfb_res$ci_hi))

                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())

lrt_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "LRT")

f_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "F")
p_val_int <- f_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]

# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: NON-PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP (R=500)

cat("\n3. Sensitivity Analysis: Bootstrap for Continuous Outcomes (R=500)...\n")
library(boot)

# Function to extract interaction coefficient
boot_interaction_coef <- function(data, indices, outcome_name) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  form_int  <- as.formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label"))
  fit_int  <- lm(form_int, data = d)
  
  # Specific extraction of interaction coefficient(s)
  coefs <- coef(fit_int)
  int_coefs <- coefs[grep("W_num:ITE_tertile_label", names(coefs))]
  
  # Returns the coefficient(s) (1 if numeric, 2 if factor; boot() handles multiple values)
  return(int_coefs)
}

cat("\n--- E. Out-of-Sample Calibration by Tertiles (Clinical Dimensions) ---\n")

# Robust function to compute ARD and its bootstrap confidence intervals
compute_ard_with_ci <- function(Y, W, n_boot = 1000) {
  n <- length(Y)
  ard_obs <- mean(Y[W == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[W == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  boot_ard <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  list(
    ARD = ard_obs,
    CI_Lo = quantile(boot_ard, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Hi = quantile(boot_ard, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

    # 2. Safety Dimension (28-day mortality)
    ard_mort <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["mortality_28d"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 3. Respiratory Dimension (Ventilator-free days)
    ard_vfd <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["VFD_28"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    data.frame(
      N_patients = nrow(.x),

      VFD_CI_Lo = ard_vfd$CI_Lo,
      VFD_CI_Hi = ard_vfd$CI_Hi
    )
  }) %>% ungroup()

# =============================================================================
# F. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Aggregated across the 5 models)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- F. Variable Importance Extraction (Aggregated) ---\n")

# Robust extraction function with NULL-safety checks
extract_variable_importance <- function(model, algo, X_colnames) {
  tryCatch({
    if (algo == "CausalForest") {
      vi <- grf::variable_importance(model)
      feats <- X_colnames
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
      vi_0 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_0)
      vi_1 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_1)
      vi_mean <- (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2
      feats <- names(vi_mean)
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_mean))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi_mean), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
      lambda_use <- tryCatch(model$lambda.min, error = function(e) model$lambda[1])
      coefs <- coef(model, s = lambda_use)
      feats <- rownames(coefs)[-1]
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", 1:(nrow(coefs)-1))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = abs(as.numeric(coefs)[-1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "XBART") {
      if (!is.null(model$tau_0$varcount) & !is.null(model$tau_1$varcount)) {
        vi_0 <- colMeans(model$tau_0$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        vi_1 <- colMeans(model$tau_1$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        feats <- X_colnames
        if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_0))
        out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else { stop("XBART object missing varcount.") }
      
    } else if (algo == "RLasso") {
      tau_beta <- model$tau_beta

      if (length(tau_beta) == length(X_colnames) + 1) {
        tau_beta <- tau_beta[-1]
      }

      if (length(tau_beta) != length(X_colnames)) {
        glmnet_obj <- model$tau_fit
        lam        <- glmnet_obj$lambda.min
        coefs      <- coef(glmnet_obj, s = lam)
        coef_vals  <- as.numeric(coefs)[-1]

        n_feats  <- min(length(coef_vals), length(X_colnames))
        tau_beta <- coef_vals[seq_len(n_feats)]
        X_colnames <- X_colnames[seq_len(n_feats)]
      }

      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = X_colnames,
        Importance = abs(tau_beta),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
    } else if (algo == "RBoost") {
      xgb_obj <- model$tau_fit$xgb_fit

      if (is.null(xgb_obj) || !inherits(xgb_obj, "xgb.Booster")) {
        stop("xgb_fit is not an xgb.Booster object")
      }

      vi <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = xgb_obj)
      feats <- vi$Feature
      
      # Restore clinical variable names
      if (all(grepl("^f[0-9]+$", feats))) {
        idx <- as.numeric(sub("^f", "", feats)) + 1 
        if (!is.null(X_colnames) && max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) <= length(X_colnames)) {
          feats <- X_colnames[idx]
        }
      }
      
      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = feats,
        Importance = vi$Gain,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    out %>% filter(!is.na(Importance))

  }, error = function(e) { 
    warning(paste("Error extracting variable importance:", conditionMessage(e)))
    return(NULL) 
  })
}

# Extraction and averaging across the 5 seeds
liste_importances <- lapply(final_models_list, function(modele_iter) {
  extract_variable_importance(model = modele_iter, algo = best_algo, X_colnames = colnames(X_mat))
})

# Execution safety check
if (all(sapply(liste_importances, is.null))) {
  stop("Critical failure: Unable to extract variable importance across all models.")
}

importance_df <- bind_rows(liste_importances) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(Importance = mean(Importance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  mutate(Importance = Importance / max(Importance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  head(20)

print(head(importance_df, 10), digits = 3)

imp_plot <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Feature, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2980B9", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Importance, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = paste0("Variable Importance (Aggregated) — ", best_algo), x = "Relative Importance", y = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

print(imp_plot)


# =============================================================================
# G. TABLE 1 BY ITE TERTILE
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- G. Generating Table 1 Stratified by Tertile ---\n")

if(!exists("covariates_X")) covariates_X <- covariates_cleaned

table1_tertiles <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = covariates_X, 
  strata = "ITE_tertile_label", 
  data = valid_final, 
  test = TRUE
)
table1_tertiles
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 6: CAUSAL ML DERIVATION & RANK-BASED SELECTION
# =============================================================================
library(caret)
library(grf)
library(glmnet)
library(dbarts)
library(rlearner)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PIPELINE STEP 6: CROSS-FITTING & CAUSAL ML DERIVATION\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. EMPIRICAL METRICS DEFINITION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. R-Loss (Squared error of Robinson's transformation)
compute_rloss <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat) {
  loss <- mean(((y - m_hat) - (w - e_hat) * preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(loss)
}

# 2. Empirical Doubly Robust Qini with overlap filter (Crump et al. 2009)
compute_dr_qini <- function(preds, y, w, m_hat, e_hat, overlap_threshold = 0.05) {
  ok <- abs(w - e_hat) > overlap_threshold
  if (sum(ok) < 20) return(NA_real_)
  
  preds_ok <- preds[ok]
  y_ok     <- y[ok]
  w_ok     <- w[ok]
  m_ok     <- m_hat[ok]
  e_ok     <- e_hat[ok]
  
  pseudo_outcome <- (y_ok - m_ok) / (w_ok - e_ok)
  
  idx <- order(preds_ok, decreasing = TRUE)
  sorted_pseudo <- pseudo_outcome[idx]
  
  cum_gains <- cumsum(sorted_pseudo)
  n <- length(cum_gains)
  
  baseline <- seq(cum_gains[n]/n, cum_gains[n], length.out = n)
  qini_area <- sum(cum_gains - baseline) / n
  
  return(qini_area)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. UNIFIED MATRIX PREPARATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

current_train <- train_final_10
dataset_label <- "10-90"

cat(sprintf("\n--- STARTING EVALUATION ON COHORT: %s ---\n", dataset_label))

dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = current_train[, covariates_cleaned])

X_mat <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = current_train[, covariates_cleaned]))

X_valid_cf <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model, newdata = valid_final_full[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_valid_cf[is.na(X_valid_cf)] <- 0

Y_vec <- current_train[[primary_outcome]]
W_vec <- as.numeric(as.character(current_train[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_vec %in% c(0, 1))) W_vec <- ifelse(W_vec == levels(as.factor(W_vec))[2], 1, 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. CROSS-FITTING OF NUISANCE PARAMETERS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat(" Generating nuisance parameters (m_hat and e_hat) via Cross-Fitting...\n")

set.seed(2026)
cv_folds <- createFolds(Y_vec, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

m_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))
e_hat_oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_vec))

df_nuisance <- data.frame(X_mat, Y = Y_vec, W = as.factor(W_vec))

for (i in 1:5) {
  test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(Y_vec), test_idx)
  
  fit_m <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("W")], 
                  num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  m_hat_oof[test_idx] <- predict(fit_m, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  
  fit_e <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[train_idx, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                  probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
  pred_probs <- predict(fit_e, data = df_nuisance[test_idx, ])$predictions
  prob_1 <- pred_probs[, which(colnames(pred_probs) == "1")]
  
  e_hat_oof[test_idx] <- pmin(pmax(prob_1, 0.02), 0.98) 
}

fit_e_global <- ranger(W ~ ., data = df_nuisance[, !names(df_nuisance) %in% c("Y")], 
                       probability = TRUE, num.threads = 2, seed = 2026)
pred_probs_valid <- predict(fit_e_global, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
e_valid_pred <- pred_probs_valid[, which(colnames(pred_probs_valid) == "1")]
e_valid_pred <- pmin(pmax(e_valid_pred, 0.02), 0.98)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. CAUSAL ALGORITHMS EVALUATION (5-FOLD CV)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

algorithms <- c("CausalForest", "TLearner_RF", "TianElasticNet", "XBART", "RLasso", "RBoost")
results_matrix <- data.frame()

for (algo in algorithms) {
  cat(" Evaluating algorithm:", algo, "\n")
  fold_rloss <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  fold_qini  <- rep(NA_real_, 5)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    test_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
    X_tr <- X_mat[-test_idx, ]; Y_tr <- Y_vec[-test_idx]; W_tr <- W_vec[-test_idx]
    X_te <- X_mat[test_idx, ];  Y_te <- Y_vec[test_idx];  W_te <- W_vec[test_idx]
    
    m_te <- m_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_te <- e_hat_oof[test_idx]
    e_tr <- e_hat_oof[-test_idx]
    
    result_i <- tryCatch({
      if (algo == "CausalForest") {
        cf <- causal_forest(X_tr, Y_tr, W_tr, W.hat = e_tr, tune.parameters = "all")
        preds_te <- predict(cf, newdata = X_te)$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
        rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 0, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 0]), num.threads = 2)
        rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_tr[W_tr == 1, ], Y = Y_tr[W_tr == 1]), num.threads = 2)
        preds_te <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions - predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_te))$predictions
      } 
      else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
        Z_tian_tr <- (2 * W_tr - 1) * Y_tr
        cv_glm <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, Z_tian_tr, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
        preds_te <- as.numeric(predict(cv_glm, newx = X_te, s = "lambda.min"))
      } 
      else if (algo == "XBART") {
        bart_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], Y_tr[W_tr==1], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        bart_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], Y_tr[W_tr==0], x.test = X_tr, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        D1 <- Y_tr[W_tr==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==1]
        D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_tr==0] - Y_tr[W_tr==0]
        tau_1 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==1, ], D1, x.test = X_te, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
        tau_0 <- bart(X_tr[W_tr==0, ], D0, x.test = X_te, verbose = FALSE)
        preds_te <- e_te * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_te) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
      } 
      else if (algo == "RLasso") {
        rl_lasso <- rlasso(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_lasso, X_te)
      } 
      else if (algo == "RBoost") {
        rl_boost <- rboost(x = X_tr, w = W_tr, y = Y_tr, p_hat = e_tr, num_search_rounds = 30)
        preds_te <- predict(rl_boost, X_te)
      }
      
      list(
        rloss = compute_rloss(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te),
        qini  = compute_dr_qini(preds_te, Y_te, W_te, m_te, e_te)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Fold ", i, " | ", algo, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
      list(rloss = NA_real_, qini = NA_real_)
    })
    
    fold_rloss[i] <- result_i$rloss
    fold_qini[i]  <- result_i$qini
  }
  
  results_matrix <- rbind(results_matrix, data.frame(
    Algorithm = algo,
    Mean_RLoss = mean(fold_rloss, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Qini = mean(fold_qini, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. NON-PARAMETRIC SELECTION (RANK-BASED BORDA METHOD)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- OVERALL RESULTS AND RANK-BASED SELECTION ---\n")

results_matrix <- results_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_RLoss = rank(Mean_RLoss, ties.method = "average"),
    Rank_Qini  = rank(-Mean_Qini, ties.method = "average"),
    Sum_Ranks  = Rank_RLoss + Rank_Qini
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sum_Ranks, Rank_RLoss)

print(results_matrix %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))))

best_algo <- results_matrix[1, "Algorithm"]

cat(sprintf("\n>>> SELECTED OPTIMAL CONFIGURATION: Algorithm %s <<<\n", best_algo))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. FINAL DERIVATION (STABILITY ACROSS 5 SEEDS)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nInitiating Stability Loop (5 random seeds) for final derivation...\n")

seeds <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)
ite_predictions_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(valid_final_full), ncol = length(seeds))
final_models_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(seeds)) {
  cat("   Training iteration", i, "with seed", seeds[i], "...\n")
  set.seed(seeds[i])
  
  if (best_algo == "CausalForest") {
    cf_model <- causal_forest(X_mat, Y_vec, W_vec, W.hat = e_hat_oof, 
                              tune.parameters = "all", seed = seeds[i])
    final_models_list[[i]] <- cf_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(cf_model, newdata = X_valid_cf)$predictions
  } 
  else if (best_algo == "TLearner_RF") {
    rf_0 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 0, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 0]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    rf_1 <- ranger(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X_mat[W_vec == 1, ], Y = Y_vec[W_vec == 1]), 
                   num.threads = 2, seed = seeds[i], importance = "permutation")
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(rf_0 = rf_0, rf_1 = rf_1, algo = "TLearner_RF")
    
    pred_0 <- predict(rf_0, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    pred_1 <- predict(rf_1, data = data.frame(X_valid_cf))$predictions
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- pred_1 - pred_0
  }
  else if (best_algo == "TianElasticNet") {
    Z_tian_train <- (2 * W_vec - 1) * Y_vec
    tian_model <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, Z_tian_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- tian_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- as.numeric(predict(tian_model, newx = X_valid_cf, s = "lambda.min"))
  }
  else if (best_algo == "XBART") {
    bart_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], Y_vec[W_vec==1], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    bart_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], Y_vec[W_vec==0], x.test = X_mat, keeptrees = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
    D1 <- Y_vec[W_vec==1] - bart_0$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==1]
    D0 <- bart_1$yhat.test.mean[W_vec==0] - Y_vec[W_vec==0]
    tau_1 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==1, ], D1, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    tau_0 <- bart(X_mat[W_vec==0, ], D0, x.test = X_valid_cf, verbose = FALSE)
    
    final_models_list[[i]] <- list(tau_1 = tau_1, tau_0 = tau_0, algo = "XBART")
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- e_valid_pred * tau_0$yhat.test.mean + (1 - e_valid_pred) * tau_1$yhat.test.mean
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RLasso") {
    rlasso_model <- rlasso(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rlasso_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rlasso_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
  else if (best_algo == "RBoost") {
    rboost_model <- rboost(x = X_mat, w = W_vec, y = Y_vec, p_hat = e_hat_oof, num_search_rounds = 30)
    final_models_list[[i]] <- rboost_model
    ite_predictions_matrix[, i] <- predict(rboost_model, X_valid_cf)
  }
}

names(final_models_list) <- paste0("seed_", seeds)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G. SAVING PROJECTION ON EXTERNAL VALIDATION SET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
valid_final_full$ITE_stabilized <- rowMeans(ite_predictions_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

file_name_data <- sprintf("Valid_%s_with_ITE_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)
file_name_models <- sprintf("Models_%s_%s_%s.rds", dataset_label, target_treatment, primary_outcome)

saveRDS(valid_final_full, file = file_name_data)
saveRDS(final_models_list, file = file_name_models)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving completed for %s cohort.\n", dataset_label))
cat("Generated files:", file_name_data, "and", file_name_models, "\n")

```




```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SECTION 7: PERFORMANCE EVALUATION & CLINICAL UTILITY
# =============================================================================
# Required dependencies
library(grf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tableone)
library(survival)
library(pracma)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  SECTION 7 — PERFORMANCE EVALUATION & CLINICAL UTILITY\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# Create output directories
#dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
#dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/tables",  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# A. TERTILE STRATIFICATION (T-Learner / Stabilized ITE)
# =============================================================================
cat("--- A. Benefit tertile stratification ---\n")

valid_final <- readRDS("Valid_10-90_with_ITE_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")

final_models_list <- readRDS("Models_10-90_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")

valid_final <- valid_final %>%
  mutate(
    ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3),
    ITE_tertile_label = factor(
      ITE_tertile, 
      levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
      labels = c("1: Low Benefit", "2: Moderate Benefit", "3: High Benefit")
    )
  )

Y_val <- as.numeric(valid_final[[primary_outcome]])
W_val <- as.numeric(as.character(valid_final[[target_treatment]]))
if(any(!W_val %in% c(0, 1))) W_val <- ifelse(W_val == levels(as.factor(W_val))[2], 1, 0)
PS_val <- valid_final$PS


# =============================================================================
# B. GLOBAL DISCRIMINATION (RATE Framework: AUTOC & Qini)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- B. Global Causal Discrimination (RATE framework) ---\n")

dummy_eval <- dummyVars(~ ., data = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned])
X_val_numeric <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_eval, newdata = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned]))
X_val_numeric[is.na(X_val_numeric)] <- 0

set.seed(2026)
evaluation_forest <- causal_forest(
  X = X_val_numeric, 
  Y = Y_val, 
  W = W_val, 
  W.hat = PS_val, 
  num.trees = 2000,
  seed = 2026
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. RATE with AUTOC weighting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rate_autoc <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
  evaluation_forest, 
  valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
  target = "AUTOC"
)

autoc_est <- rate_autoc$estimate
autoc_se <- rate_autoc$std.err
autoc_ci_lo <- autoc_est - 1.96 * autoc_se
autoc_ci_hi <- autoc_est + 1.96 * autoc_se
autoc_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(autoc_est / autoc_se))

cat("1. RATE (Target = AUTOC)\n")
cat(sprintf("   Estimate : %.3f\n", autoc_est))
cat(sprintf("   SE       : %.3f\n", autoc_se))
cat(sprintf("   95%% CI   : [%.3f ; %.3f]\n", autoc_ci_lo, autoc_ci_hi))
cat(sprintf("   p-value  : %s\n\n", format.pval(autoc_pval, digits = 3)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RATE with Qini weighting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rate_qini <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
  evaluation_forest, 
  valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
  target = "QINI"
)

qini_est <- rate_qini$estimate
qini_se <- rate_qini$std.err
qini_ci_lo <- qini_est - 1.96 * qini_se
qini_ci_hi <- qini_est + 1.96 * qini_se
qini_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(qini_est / qini_se))

cat("2. RATE (Target = Qini)\n")
cat(sprintf("   Estimate : %.3f\n", qini_est))
cat(sprintf("   SE       : %.3f\n", qini_se))
cat(sprintf("   95%% CI   : [%.3f ; %.3f]\n", qini_ci_lo, qini_ci_hi))
cat(sprintf("   p-value  : %s\n", format.pval(qini_pval, digits = 3)))
# =============================================================================
# C. C-FOR-BENEFIT (van Klaveren concordance)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- C. C-for-benefit (van Klaveren et al. 2018) ---\n")

compute_c_for_benefit <- function(preds, y, w, max_pairs = 400, n_iter = 50) {
  idx_1 <- which(w == 1)
  idx_0 <- which(w == 0)
  n_pairs <- min(length(idx_1), length(idx_0), max_pairs)
  
  if (n_pairs < 20) return(list(c_stat = NA_real_, n_pairs = n_pairs))
  c_indices <- numeric(n_iter)
  
  set.seed(2026)
  for (k in 1:n_iter) {
    m1 <- sample(idx_1, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    m0 <- sample(idx_0, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
    
    obs_ben  <- y[m1] - y[m0]
    pred_ben <- (preds[m1] + preds[m0]) / 2
    
    pd <- outer(pred_ben, pred_ben, "-")
    od <- outer(obs_ben,  obs_ben,  "-")
    ut <- upper.tri(pd)
    pd_v <- pd[ut]; od_v <- od[ut]
    
    non_tied <- abs(pd_v) > .Machine$double.eps
    pd_v <- pd_v[non_tied]; od_v <- od_v[non_tied]
    
    conc <- sum(sign(pd_v) == sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    disc <- sum(sign(pd_v) != sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
    tot  <- conc + disc
    c_indices[k] <- if (tot == 0) 0.5 else conc / tot
  }
  
  list(
    c_stat = mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lo = quantile(c_indices, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_hi = quantile(c_indices, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n_pairs
  )
}

cfb_res <- compute_c_for_benefit(valid_final$ITE_stabilized, Y_val, W_val)
cat(sprintf("C-for-benefit: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f - %.3f)\n", 
            cfb_res$c_stat, cfb_res$ci_lo, cfb_res$ci_hi))

# =============================================================================
# D. INTERACTION TEST (Likelihood Ratio Test)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- D. Interaction Test (Treatment * Tertile) ---\n")

valid_final$W_num <- W_val
base_mod <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num + ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())
int_mod  <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label")), 
                data = valid_final, family = gaussian())

lrt_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "LRT")
p_val_interaction <- lrt_test$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

# F-test is required for a Gaussian model (estimated variance)

f_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "F")
p_val_int <- f_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]

cat(" Interaction (F-Test) p-value:", format.pval(p_val_int, digits = 3), "\n")


# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: NON-PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP (R=500)

cat("\n3. Sensitivity Analysis: Bootstrap for Continuous Outcomes (R=500)...\n")
library(boot)

# Function to extract interaction coefficient
boot_interaction_coef <- function(data, indices, outcome_name) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  form_int  <- as.formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label"))
  fit_int  <- lm(form_int, data = d)
  
  # Specific extraction of interaction coefficient(s)
  coefs <- coef(fit_int)
  int_coefs <- coefs[grep("W_num:ITE_tertile_label", names(coefs))]
  
  # Returns the coefficient(s) (1 if numeric, 2 if factor; boot() handles multiple values)
  return(int_coefs)
}

# Run bootstrap for VAPFD_28
set.seed(2026)
boot_lrt<- boot(data = valid_final, statistic = boot_interaction_coef, R = 500, outcome_name = "VAPFD_28")


cat("Bootstrap completed.\n\n")

# --- DISPLAY RESULTS ---

cat("--- BOOTSTRAP RESULTS: ---\n")
print(boot_lrt)
cat("\n95% Confidence Interval (Percentile):\n")
# Parameter index=1 targets the first interaction term
print(boot.ci(boot_lrt, type = "perc", index = 1))

# =============================================================================
# E. CALIBRATION BY TERTILE (MULTIPLE OUTCOMES WITH BOOTSTRAP CI)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- E. Out-of-Sample Calibration by Tertiles (Clinical Dimensions) ---\n")

# Robust function to compute ARD and its bootstrap confidence intervals
compute_ard_with_ci <- function(Y, W, n_boot = 1000) {
  n <- length(Y)
  ard_obs <- mean(Y[W == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[W == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  boot_ard <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  list(
    ARD = ard_obs,
    CI_Lo = quantile(boot_ard, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_Hi = quantile(boot_ard, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

set.seed(2026)
calibration_results <- valid_final %>%
  group_by(ITE_tertile_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    # 1. Infectious Dimension (Dynamic primary outcome)
    ard_prim <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[[primary_outcome]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 2. Safety Dimension (28-day mortality)
    ard_mort <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["mortality_28d"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    # 3. Respiratory Dimension (Ventilator-free days)
    ard_vfd <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["VFD_28"]]), .x$W_num)
    
    data.frame(
      N_patients = nrow(.x),
      Mean_Predicted_ITE = mean(.x$ITE_stabilized, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ARD_Primary = ard_prim$ARD,
      Primary_CI_Lo = ard_prim$CI_Lo,
      Primary_CI_Hi = ard_prim$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_Mortality = ard_mort$ARD,
      Mortality_CI_Lo = ard_mort$CI_Lo,
      Mortality_CI_Hi = ard_mort$CI_Hi,
      
      ARD_VFD_28 = ard_vfd$ARD,
      VFD_CI_Lo = ard_vfd$CI_Lo,
      VFD_CI_Hi = ard_vfd$CI_Hi
    )
  }) %>% ungroup()

print(calibration_results, digits = 3)

# =============================================================================
# F. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Aggregated across the 5 models)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n--- F. Variable Importance Extraction (Aggregated) ---\n")

# Robust extraction function with NULL-safety checks
extract_variable_importance <- function(model, algo, X_colnames) {
  tryCatch({
    if (algo == "CausalForest") {
      vi <- grf::variable_importance(model)
      feats <- X_colnames
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
      vi_0 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_0)
      vi_1 <- ranger::importance(model$rf_1)
      vi_mean <- (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2
      feats <- names(vi_mean)
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_mean))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = as.numeric(vi_mean), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
      lambda_use <- tryCatch(model$lambda.min, error = function(e) model$lambda[1])
      coefs <- coef(model, s = lambda_use)
      feats <- rownames(coefs)[-1]
      if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", 1:(nrow(coefs)-1))
      out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = abs(as.numeric(coefs)[-1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      
    } else if (algo == "XBART") {
      if (!is.null(model$tau_0$varcount) & !is.null(model$tau_1$varcount)) {
        vi_0 <- colMeans(model$tau_0$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        vi_1 <- colMeans(model$tau_1$varcount, na.rm = TRUE)
        feats <- X_colnames
        if (is.null(feats)) feats <- paste0("Covariate_", seq_along(vi_0))
        out <- data.frame(Feature = feats, Importance = (vi_0 + vi_1) / 2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else { stop("XBART object missing varcount.") }
      
    } else if (algo == "RLasso") {
      tau_beta <- model$tau_beta

      if (length(tau_beta) == length(X_colnames) + 1) {
        tau_beta <- tau_beta[-1]
      }

      if (length(tau_beta) != length(X_colnames)) {
        glmnet_obj <- model$tau_fit
        lam        <- glmnet_obj$lambda.min
        coefs      <- coef(glmnet_obj, s = lam)
        coef_vals  <- as.numeric(coefs)[-1]

        n_feats  <- min(length(coef_vals), length(X_colnames))
        tau_beta <- coef_vals[seq_len(n_feats)]
        X_colnames <- X_colnames[seq_len(n_feats)]
      }

      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = X_colnames,
        Importance = abs(tau_beta),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
    } else if (algo == "RBoost") {
      xgb_obj <- model$tau_fit$xgb_fit

      if (is.null(xgb_obj) || !inherits(xgb_obj, "xgb.Booster")) {
        stop("xgb_fit is not an xgb.Booster object")
      }

      vi <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = xgb_obj)
      feats <- vi$Feature
      
      # Restore clinical variable names
      if (all(grepl("^f[0-9]+$", feats))) {
        idx <- as.numeric(sub("^f", "", feats)) + 1 
        if (!is.null(X_colnames) && max(idx, na.rm = TRUE) <= length(X_colnames)) {
          feats <- X_colnames[idx]
        }
      }
      
      out <- data.frame(
        Feature    = feats,
        Importance = vi$Gain,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    out %>% filter(!is.na(Importance))

  }, error = function(e) { 
    warning(paste("Error extracting variable importance:", conditionMessage(e)))
    return(NULL) 
  })
}

# Extraction and averaging across the 5 seeds
liste_importances <- lapply(final_models_list, function(modele_iter) {
  extract_variable_importance(model = modele_iter, algo = best_algo, X_colnames = colnames(X_mat))
})

# Execution safety check
if (all(sapply(liste_importances, is.null))) {
  stop("Critical failure: Unable to extract variable importance across all models.")
}

importance_df <- bind_rows(liste_importances) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(Importance = mean(Importance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%

  head(20)

print(head(importance_df, 10), digits = 3)

imp_plot <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Feature, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2980B9", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Importance, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = paste0("Variable Importance (Aggregated) — ", best_algo), x = "Relative Importance", y = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

print(imp_plot)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# BRIDGE SECTION 6 -> 7: Testing saved models on trimmed validation sets
# =============================================================================

library(grf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tableone)
library(survival)
library(pracma)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(dbarts)
library(rlearner)
library(ranger)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)



# ── 1. Load saved models ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
models_full  <- readRDS("Models_Full_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")
models_025   <- readRDS("Models_2.5_97.5_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")
models_05    <- readRDS("Models_5-95_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")
models_10    <- readRDS("Models_10-90_sedation_vacation_VAPFD_28.rds")

best_algo_full <- "RLasso"       # <- adjust according to selection
best_algo_025  <- "RLasso"       # <- adjust according to selection
best_algo_05   <- "CausalForest" # <- adjust according to selection
best_algo_10   <- "RLasso"       # <- adjust according to selection

# ── 2. Define trimmed validation sets ────────────────────────────────────────
# dummy_model must be identical to the one used in Section 6
# dummy_model <- readRDS("dummy_model.rds") # if previously saved
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_final_full[, covariates_cleaned])

# Available validation sets (PS locally estimated on validation data)
valid_sets <- list(
  "Valid_Full"  = valid_final_full,
  "Valid_025"   = valid_final_025,
  "Valid_05"    = valid_final_05,
  "Valid_10"    = valid_final_10
)

# Models corresponding to each training scenario
train_scenarios <- list(
  "Full"     = list(models = models_full,  algo = best_algo_full),
  "Trim_025" = list(models = models_025,   algo = best_algo_025),
  "Trim_05"  = list(models = models_05,    algo = best_algo_05),
  "Trim_10"  = list(models = models_10,    algo = best_algo_10)
)

# ── 3. Loop: for each train_scenario x valid_set combination ─────────────────
results_grid <- list()

for (train_name in names(train_scenarios)) {
  
  scenario    <- train_scenarios[[train_name]]
  models_list <- scenario$models
  algo        <- scenario$algo
  
  for (valid_name in names(valid_sets)) {
    
    cat(sprintf("\n>>> Train: %s | Valid: %s | Algo: %s\n",
                train_name, valid_name, algo))
    
    current_valid <- valid_sets[[valid_name]]
    
    # ── A. Validation X matrix (same dummy_model as train) ──────────────────
    X_val <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_model,
                                newdata = current_valid[, covariates_cleaned]))
    X_val[is.na(X_val)] <- 0
    
    Y_val <- as.numeric(current_valid[[primary_outcome]])
    W_val <- as.numeric(as.character(current_valid[[target_treatment]]))
    
    # ── B. PS locally re-estimated on this validation set ───────────────────
    # Addresses covariate balance drift
    df_val_nuisance <- data.frame(X_val, W = as.factor(W_val))
    
    fit_e_local <- ranger(
      W ~ .,
      data        = df_val_nuisance[, !names(df_val_nuisance) %in% 
                                       c(primary_outcome)],
      probability = TRUE,
      num.threads = 2,
      seed        = 2026
    )
    
    pred_probs_val <- predict(fit_e_local, 
                               data = df_val_nuisance)$predictions
    e_val_local    <- pred_probs_val[, which(colnames(pred_probs_val) == "1")]
    e_val_local    <- pmin(pmax(e_val_local, 0.02), 0.98)
    
    # ── C. ITE prediction on validation set (from saved models) ─────────────
    seeds <- c(101, 202, 303, 404, 505)
    ite_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(current_valid), 
                      ncol = length(models_list))
    
    for (i in seq_along(models_list)) {
      m <- models_list[[i]]
      
      ite_mat[, i] <- tryCatch({
        
        if (algo == "CausalForest") {
          predict(m, newdata = X_val)$predictions
          
        } else if (algo == "TLearner_RF") {
          predict(m$rf_1, data = data.frame(X_val))$predictions -
          predict(m$rf_0, data = data.frame(X_val))$predictions
          
        } else if (algo == "TianElasticNet") {
          as.numeric(predict(m, newx = X_val, s = "lambda.min"))
          
        } else if (algo == "XBART") {
          # Case 1: valid_name == "Valid_Full" -> identical lengths
          if (valid_name == "Valid_Full") {
            
            e_val_local * m$tau_0$yhat.test.mean +
            (1 - e_val_local) * m$tau_1$yhat.test.mean
            
          } else {
            # Case 2: trimmed validation set -> subset by participant_id
            
            if (!"participant_id" %in% names(valid_final_full)) {
              # Fallback if participant_id is missing: subset by rownames
              idx_in_full <- as.integer(rownames(current_valid))
            } else {
              idx_in_full <- which(
                valid_final_full$participant_id %in% 
                current_valid$participant_id
              )
            }
            
            if (length(idx_in_full) != nrow(current_valid)) {
              warning(sprintf(
                "XBART [%s x %s]: %d indices found for %d rows",
                train_name, valid_name,
                length(idx_in_full), nrow(current_valid)
              ))
              rep(NA_real_, nrow(current_valid))
              
            } else {
              tau0_sub <- m$tau_0$yhat.test.mean[idx_in_full]
              tau1_sub <- m$tau_1$yhat.test.mean[idx_in_full]
              e_val_local * tau0_sub + (1 - e_val_local) * tau1_sub
            }
          }
        }
        else if (algo == "RLasso") {
          predict(m, X_val)
          
        } else if (algo == "RBoost") {
          predict(m, X_val)
        }
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning("Seed ", i, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
        rep(NA_real_, nrow(current_valid))
      })
    }
    
    current_valid$ITE_stabilized <- rowMeans(ite_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    current_valid$e_local        <- e_val_local
    
    # ── D. Save results ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    key <- paste0(train_name, "_on_", valid_name)
    results_grid[[key]] <- list(
      data        = current_valid,
      e_val_local = e_val_local,
      X_val       = X_val,
      Y_val       = Y_val,
      W_val       = W_val,
      algo        = algo,
      train_name  = train_name,
      valid_name  = valid_name
    )
    
    file_out <- sprintf("Valid_ITE_%s_%s_%s_%s.rds",
                        train_name, valid_name,
                        target_treatment, primary_outcome)
    saveRDS(results_grid[[key]], file = file_out)
    
    cat(sprintf("  [OK] ITE computed | N=%d | Mean ITE=%.3f | File: %s\n",
                nrow(current_valid),
                mean(current_valid$ITE_stabilized, na.rm = TRUE),
                file_out))
  }
}

cat("\nFull grid generated:", length(results_grid), "combinations.\n")
cat("Available keys:\n")
cat(paste(" -", names(results_grid)), sep = "\n")
```
