```{r}
cat("  SECTION 7 — AUTOMATED PERFORMANCE EVALUATION & CLINICAL UTILITY\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

library(boot)
library(dplyr)
library(grf)
library(caret)

master_evaluation_results <- data.frame()
calibration_list <- list()

for (scen_name in names(results_grid)) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\n--- EVALUATING SCENARIO: %s ---\n", scen_name))
  
  # Object extraction
  valid_final <- results_grid[[scen_name]]
  
  # SAFETY FILTER: Coerce to data.frame
  if (!inherits(valid_final, "data.frame")) {
    if (is.list(valid_final) && "data" %in% names(valid_final)) {
      valid_final <- valid_final$data
    } else {
      valid_final <- as.data.frame(valid_final)
    }
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # A. TERTILE STRATIFICATION
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  valid_final <- valid_final %>%
    mutate(
      ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3),
      ITE_tertile_label = factor(
        ITE_tertile, 
        levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
        labels = c("1: Low Benefit", "2: Moderate Benefit", "3: High Benefit")
      )
    )
  
  Y_val <- as.numeric(valid_final[[primary_outcome]])
  W_val <- as.numeric(as.character(valid_final[[target_treatment]]))
  if(any(!W_val %in% c(0, 1))) W_val <- ifelse(W_val == levels(as.factor(W_val))[2], 1, 0)
  PS_val <- valid_final$PS
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # B. GLOBAL DISCRIMINATION (RATE Framework: AUTOC & Qini)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  dummy_eval <- dummyVars(~ ., data = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned])
  X_val_numeric <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_eval, newdata = valid_final[, covariates_cleaned]))
  X_val_numeric[is.na(X_val_numeric)] <- 0
  
  set.seed(2026)
  evaluation_forest <- causal_forest(
    X = X_val_numeric, 
    Y = Y_val, 
    W = W_val, 
    W.hat = PS_val, 
    num.trees = 2000,
    seed = 2026
  )
  
  # 1. RATE (Target = AUTOC)
  rate_autoc <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
    evaluation_forest, 
    valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
    target = "AUTOC"
  )
  autoc_est <- rate_autoc$estimate
  autoc_se <- rate_autoc$std.err
  autoc_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(autoc_est / autoc_se))
  
  # 2. RATE (Target = Qini)
  rate_qini <- rank_average_treatment_effect(
    evaluation_forest, 
    valid_final$ITE_stabilized, 
    target = "QINI"
  )
  qini_est <- rate_qini$estimate
  qini_se <- rate_qini$std.err
  qini_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(qini_est / qini_se))
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # C. C-FOR-BENEFIT (van Klaveren concordance)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  compute_c_for_benefit <- function(preds, y, w, max_pairs = 400, n_iter = 50) {
    idx_1 <- which(w == 1)
    idx_0 <- which(w == 0)
    n_pairs <- min(length(idx_1), length(idx_0), max_pairs)
    
    if (n_pairs < 20) return(list(c_stat = NA_real_, n_pairs = n_pairs))
    c_indices <- numeric(n_iter)
    
    set.seed(2026)
    for (k in 1:n_iter) {
      m1 <- sample(idx_1, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
      m0 <- sample(idx_0, n_pairs, replace = FALSE)
      
      obs_ben  <- y[m1] - y[m0]
      pred_ben <- (preds[m1] + preds[m0]) / 2
      
      pd <- outer(pred_ben, pred_ben, "-")
      od <- outer(obs_ben,  obs_ben,  "-")
      ut <- upper.tri(pd)
      pd_v <- pd[ut]; od_v <- od[ut]
      
      non_tied <- abs(pd_v) > .Machine$double.eps
      pd_v <- pd_v[non_tied]; od_v <- od_v[non_tied]
      
      conc <- sum(sign(pd_v) == sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
      disc <- sum(sign(pd_v) != sign(od_v) & abs(od_v) > .Machine$double.eps)
      tot  <- conc + disc
      c_indices[k] <- if (tot == 0) 0.5 else conc / tot
    }
    
    list(
      c_stat = mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE),
      ci_lo = quantile(c_indices, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      ci_hi = quantile(c_indices, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n_pairs
    )
  }
  
  cfb_res <- compute_c_for_benefit(valid_final$ITE_stabilized, Y_val, W_val)
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # D. INTERACTION TEST (Likelihood Ratio Test & Bootstrap)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  valid_final$W_num <- W_val
  base_mod <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num + ITE_tertile_label")), 
                  data = valid_final, family = gaussian())
  int_mod  <- glm(as.formula(paste(primary_outcome, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label")), 
                  data = valid_final, family = gaussian())
  
  f_test <- anova(base_mod, int_mod, test = "F")
  p_val_int_f <- f_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  
  boot_interaction_coef <- function(data, indices, outcome_name) {
    d <- data[indices, ]
    form_int  <- as.formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ W_num * ITE_tertile_label"))
    fit_int  <- lm(form_int, data = d)
    coefs <- coef(fit_int)
    int_coefs <- coefs[grep("W_num:ITE_tertile_label", names(coefs))]
    return(int_coefs)
  }
  
  set.seed(2026)
  boot_lrt <- boot(data = valid_final, statistic = boot_interaction_coef, R = 500, outcome_name = primary_outcome)
  boot_ci_obj <- boot.ci(boot_lrt, type = "perc", index = 1)
  boot_ci_lo <- boot_ci_obj$percent[4]
  boot_ci_hi <- boot_ci_obj$percent[5]
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # E. CALIBRATION BY TERTILE
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  compute_ard_with_ci <- function(Y, W, n_boot = 1000) {
    n <- length(Y)
    ard_obs <- mean(Y[W == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[W == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    boot_ard <- replicate(n_boot, {
      idx <- sample(n, n, replace = TRUE)
      mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(Y[idx][W[idx] == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    
    list(
      ARD = ard_obs,
      CI_Lo = quantile(boot_ard, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      CI_Hi = quantile(boot_ard, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  
  set.seed(2026)
  calibration_results <- valid_final %>%
    group_by(ITE_tertile_label) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      ard_prim <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[[primary_outcome]]), .x$W_num)
      ard_mort <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["mortality_28d"]]), .x$W_num)
      ard_vfd <- compute_ard_with_ci(as.numeric(.x[["VFD_28"]]), .x$W_num)
      
      data.frame(
        N_patients = nrow(.x),
        Mean_Predicted_ITE = mean(.x$ITE_stabilized, na.rm = TRUE),
        ARD_Primary = ard_prim$ARD,
        Primary_CI_Lo = ard_prim$CI_Lo,
        Primary_CI_Hi = ard_prim$CI_Hi,
        ARD_Mortality = ard_mort$ARD,
        Mortality_CI_Lo = ard_mort$CI_Lo,
        Mortality_CI_Hi = ard_mort$CI_Hi, ARD_VFD_28 = ard_vfd$ARD,
        VFD_CI_Lo = ard_vfd$CI_Lo,
        VFD_CI_Hi = ard_vfd$CI_Hi
      )
    }) %>% ungroup()
  
  calibration_list[[scen_name]] <- calibration_results
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # F. SCENARIO RESULTS CONSOLIDATION
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  master_evaluation_results <- rbind(
    master_evaluation_results, 
    data.frame(
      Scenario = scen_name,
      AUTOC_Est = autoc_est,
      AUTOC_Pval = autoc_pval,
      Qini_Est = qini_est,
      Qini_Pval = qini_pval,
      C_for_Benefit = cfb_res$c_stat,
      Pval_Interaction_F = p_val_int_f,
      Boot_Int_CI_Lo = boot_ci_lo,
      Boot_Int_CI_Hi = boot_ci_hi
    )
  )
  
  cat("   -> Evaluation completed.\n")
}

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  OVERALL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY (16 SCENARIOS)\n")
cat("=============================================================\n")

master_evaluation_results <- master_evaluation_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

print(master_evaluation_results)
```

```{r}
cat("\n--- H. Generating and Displaying JAMA-style HTE Figures ---\n")

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

jama_plots_list <- list()

for (scen_name in names(results_grid)) {
  
  cat(sprintf(" Displaying plot for scenario: %s...\n", scen_name))
  
  # 1. SCENARIO DATA EXTRACTION AND SAFETY CHECKS
  valid_final <- results_grid[[scen_name]]
  
  if (!inherits(valid_final, "data.frame")) {
    if (is.list(valid_final) && "data" %in% names(valid_final)) {
      valid_final <- valid_final$data
    } else {
      valid_final <- as.data.frame(valid_final)
    }
  }
  
  # RE-INTEGRATE TERTILE STRATIFICATION
  valid_final <- valid_final %>%
    mutate(
      ITE_tertile = ntile(ITE_stabilized, 3),
      ITE_tertile_label = factor(
        ITE_tertile, 
        levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
        labels = c("1: Low Benefit", "2: Moderate Benefit", "3: High Benefit")
      )
    )
  
  df_calibration <- calibration_list[[scen_name]]
  
  if (is.null(valid_final) || is.null(df_calibration)) {
    warning(sprintf("Missing data for %s. Plot skipped.", scen_name))
    next
  }
  
  # 2. DATA PREPARATION FOR PANEL A
  df_panel_A <- valid_final %>%
    filter(!is.na(ITE_stabilized)) %>%
    arrange(ITE_stabilized) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      tertile_color_group = case_when(
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 1 ~ "Lower third",
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 2 ~ "Middle third",
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 3 ~ "Upper third"
      ),
      tertile_color_group = factor(tertile_color_group, levels = c("Lower third", "Middle third", "Upper third"))
    )

  # 3. DATA PREPARATION FOR PANEL B
  df_panel_B <- df_calibration %>%
    mutate(
      tertile_color_group = case_when(
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 1 ~ "Lower third",
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 2 ~ "Middle third",
        as.numeric(ITE_tertile_label) == 3 ~ "Upper third"
      ),
      tertile_color_group = factor(tertile_color_group, levels = c("Lower third", "Middle third", "Upper third")),
      x_label = case_when(
        tertile_color_group == "Lower third" ~ "Lower third\n(predicted to benefit\nfrom control)",
        tertile_color_group == "Middle third" ~ "Middle third\n(predicted similar\noutcomes)",
        tertile_color_group == "Upper third" ~ "Upper third\n(predicted to benefit\nfrom treatment)"
      ),
      x_label = factor(x_label, levels = unique(x_label))
    )

  # 4. DYNAMIC Y-AXIS PARAMETERIZATION
  y_min <- min(c(df_panel_A$ITE_stabilized, df_panel_B$Primary_CI_Lo), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(c(df_panel_A$ITE_stabilized, df_panel_B$Primary_CI_Hi), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits <- c(y_min - abs(y_min)*0.15, y_max + abs(y_max)*0.15)

  jama_colors <- c("Lower third" = "#2980B9", "Middle third" = "#95A5A6", "Upper third" = "#C0392B")
  text_favors_up <- "Favors\ntreatment"
  text_favors_down <- "Favors\ncontrol"

  # 5. PANEL A CONSTRUCTION
  max_rank <- max(df_panel_A$rank)
  pA <- ggplot(df_panel_A, aes(x = rank, y = ITE_stabilized, color = tertile_color_group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("segment", x = max_rank * 0.95, xend = max_rank * 0.95, 
             y = y_max * 0.2, yend = y_max * 0.9, 
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), 
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max_rank * 0.95, y = y_max * 0.55, 
             label = text_favors_up, hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, lineheight = 1) +
    annotate("segment", x = max_rank * 0.95, xend = max_rank * 0.95, 
             y = y_min * 0.2, yend = y_min * 0.9, 
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), 
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max_rank * 0.95, y = y_min * 0.55, 
             label = text_favors_down, hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, lineheight = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = jama_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Patients ranked by predicted individualized treatment effect",
      y = "Predicted individualized treatment effect (VAPFD-28)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.15, 0.85),
      legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    )

  # 6. PANEL B CONSTRUCTION
  pB <- ggplot(df_panel_B, aes(x = x_label, y = ARD_Primary, color = tertile_color_group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Primary_CI_Lo, ymax = Primary_CI_Hi), 
                  width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8, color = "gray40") +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    annotate("segment", x = 3.4, xend = 3.4, 
             y = y_max * 0.2, yend = y_max * 0.9, 
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), 
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.4, y = y_max * 0.55, 
             label = text_favors_up, hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, lineheight = 1) +
    annotate("segment", x = 3.4, xend = 3.4, 
             y = y_min * 0.2, yend = y_min * 0.9, 
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), 
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.4, y = y_min * 0.55, 
             label = text_favors_down, hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, lineheight = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = jama_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 3.5), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      x = "Patients grouped by predicted\nindividualized treatment effect",
      y = "Absolute risk difference (Observed)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
    )

  # 7. ASSEMBLY AND DISPLAY
  jama_figure <- pA + pB + plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("Heterogeneous Treatment Effect - Scenario: %s", scen_name),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14)),
    tag_levels = 'A'
  )
  
  jama_plots_list[[scen_name]] <- jama_figure
  
  # EXPLICIT DISPLAY INSTRUCTION
  print(jama_figure)
  
  # Optional pause to allow the graphics rendering engine to display each plot during batch execution
  Sys.sleep(1) 
}
```
